def code_inputs():
    require(regular(Path(__file__)) == _CODE, "Loaded promoter changed")
    require(regular(Path(native.__file__)) == native._CODE, "Loaded replay dependency changed")
    result = {Path(__file__): _CODE, Path(native.__file__): native._CODE}
    for p, data in source._LOADED_CODE.items():
        require(regular(p) == data, "Loaded source dependency changed")
        result[p] = data
    return result


def capture_anchors(proof):
    proof = bound_path(proof)
    return {p: proof.with_name(proof.stem + ".before-" + p.name) for p in OUTPUTS}


@contextmanager
def reserve_capture(proof):
    """Reserve all three proof outputs relative to one held, verified parent FD."""
    proof = bound_path(proof)
    parent = proof.parent
    intended = parent.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(intended.st_mode), "Proof parent must already exist")
    identity = publication._identity(intended)
    fd = os.open(parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    files = {}
    handed_over = False

    def check():
        require(
            parent == parent.resolve() and publication._identity(parent.lstat()) == identity,
            "Proof parent changed",
        )
        for path, handle in files.items():
            info = path.lstat()
            require(
                path == path.resolve()
                and stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
                and info.st_nlink == 1
                and publication._identity(info) == publication._identity(os.fstat(handle)),
                "Reserved proof output changed",
            )

    try:
        require(
            publication._identity(os.fstat(fd)) == identity,
            "Proof parent changed during acquisition",
        )
        check()
        for path in (proof, *capture_anchors(proof).values()):
            check()
            files[path] = os.open(
                path.name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600, dir_fd=fd
            )
            check()
        handed_over = True
        yield files, check
    finally:
        if not handed_over:
            for path, handle in files.items():
                try:
                    info = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=fd, follow_symlinks=False)
                    if publication._identity(info) == publication._identity(os.fstat(handle)):
                        os.unlink(path.name, dir_fd=fd)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass
        for handle in files.values():
            os.close(handle)
        os.close(fd)


def write_fd(handle, data):
    view = memoryview(data)
    while view:
        written = os.write(handle, view)
        require(written > 0, "Proof write made no progress")
        view = view[written:]
    os.fsync(handle)


def capture_sources(root, source_log, proof, *, apply=False):
    root, source_log, proof = checked_root(root), bound_path(source_log), bound_path(proof)
    inputs, result = source.source_receipt(root, source_log)
    inputs.update(code_inputs())
    paths = ingredient_paths(root)
    anchors = capture_anchors(proof)
    require(proof.parent.is_dir(), "Proof parent must already exist")
    require(
        not any(os.path.lexists(p) for p in (proof, *anchors.values())),
        "Proof output already exists",
    )
    doc = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "kind": "stock-cas-completed-source-capture",
        "approval": APPROVAL,
        "root": str(root),
        "source_log": str(source_log),
        "source_result": result,
        "source_receipt_sha256": digest(inputs[source_log]),
        "input_sha256": {str(p): digest(b) for p, b in inputs.items()},
        "anchors": {str(p): {"path": str(anchors[p]), "sha256": BEFORE[p]} for p in OUTPUTS},
        "state": "complete",
    }
    policy.validate_scope(root, inputs, paths)
    if not apply:
        return {"applied": False, "approval": APPROVAL, "capture": doc}
    with reserve_capture(proof) as (handles, check):
        check()
        policy.validate_scope(root, inputs, paths)
        for p, destination in anchors.items():
            write_fd(handles[destination], inputs[root / p])
            check()
        policy.validate_scope(root, inputs, paths)
        write_fd(handles[proof], encoded(doc))
        check()
        policy.validate_scope(root, inputs, paths)
    return {"applied": True, "approval": APPROVAL, "proof_sha256": digest(regular(proof))}


def _captured_sources(root, source_log, proof):
    """Internal historical reconstruction; NOT a completed canonical transition proof."""
    root, source_log, proof = checked_root(root), bound_path(source_log), bound_path(proof)
    proof_raw = regular(proof)
    doc = json.loads(proof_raw)
    require(
        proof_raw == encoded(doc)
        and set(doc)
        == {
            "schema_version",
            "kind",
            "approval",
            "root",
            "source_log",
            "source_result",
            "source_receipt_sha256",
            "input_sha256",
            "anchors",
            "state",
        },
        "Completed source capture bytes/fields differ",
    )
    require(
        doc.get("schema_version") == 1
        and doc.get("kind") == "stock-cas-completed-source-capture"
        and doc.get("state") == "complete"
        and doc.get("root") == str(root)
        and doc.get("source_log") == str(source_log)
        and doc.get("approval") == APPROVAL,
        "Completed source capture contract differs",
    )
    anchors = capture_anchors(proof)
    require(
        doc["anchors"] == {str(p): {"path": str(anchors[p]), "sha256": BEFORE[p]} for p in OUTPUTS},
        "Historical anchor substitutions differ",
    )
    old = {p: regular(path) for p, path in anchors.items()}
    require(
        all(digest(b) == BEFORE[p] for p, b in old.items()), "Captured historical anchor differs"
    )
    current = {p: regular(root / p) for p in source.OWNERS}
    timestamp = source.verify_complete(current)
    paths = ingredient_paths(root)
    require({root / p for p in source.OWNERS} <= paths, "Missing corrected owner")
    inputs = {p: regular(p) for p in paths}
    inputs.update(source.evidence_inputs(root))
    inputs.update(source.native_code_inputs())
    for p, expected in source._LOADED_CODE.items():
        require(regular(p) == expected, "Loaded source dependency changed")
        inputs[p] = expected
    for p in source.ANCHORS:
        data = old[p] if p in OUTPUTS else regular(root / p)
        require(digest(data) == BEFORE[p], "Protected historical source anchor changed")
        inputs[root / p] = data
    historical = inputs | {root / p: source.frozen(p) for p in source.OWNERS}
    result = {
        "phase": "sources",
        "approval": APPROVAL,
        "timestamp": timestamp,
        "evidence_manifest": str(root / source.MANIFEST),
        "evidence_manifest_sha256": source.MANIFEST_SHA,
        "input_sha256": {str(p): digest(b) for p, b in historical.items()},
        "output_sha256": {str(p): digest(b) for p, b in current.items()},
        "records": [
            {
                "source_record": str(p),
                "shape": source.META["owners"][str(p)]["shape"],
                "before_yaml_sha256": source.META["owners"][str(p)]["sha256"],
                "after_yaml_sha256": digest(current[p]),
                "change": source.change_text(p),
                "verification": (
                    "Exact reviewed owner preimage and primary chemistry evidence bound by "
                    f"{source.MANIFEST}@sha256={source.MANIFEST_SHA}; only the explicit delete/set matrix "
                    "and one history event are applied. " + APPROVAL
                ),
            }
            for p in source.OWNERS
        ],
    }
    require(
        doc["source_result"] == result,
        "Captured source result differs from exact frozen writer contract",
    )
    inputs[source_log] = policy.completed_receipt(
        source_log, result, root, changed=set(source.OWNERS)
    )
    require(
        digest(inputs[source_log]) == doc["source_receipt_sha256"],
        "Captured source receipt changed",
    )
    for p, backup in source.backups(source_log).items():
        inputs[backup] = regular(backup)
        require(inputs[backup] == source.frozen(p), "Source backup changed")
    inputs.update(
        publication.completed_journal(
            root,
            source_log,
            json.loads(inputs[source_log]),
            previous={p: source.frozen(p) for p in source.OWNERS},
        )
    )
    inputs.update(code_inputs())
    require(
        doc["input_sha256"] == {str(p): digest(b) for p, b in inputs.items()},
        "Completed source capture input inventory differs",
    )
    # Historical identities are retained in the proof above. Current-scope checks
    # use actual current bytes; promote must prove BOTH exact output transitions.
    inputs.update({root / p: regular(root / p) for p in OUTPUTS})
    inputs.update({anchors[p]: b for p, b in old.items()})
    inputs[proof] = proof_raw
    policy.validate_scope(root, inputs, paths)
    return inputs, result, old


def table(data):
    lines = data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if not line.startswith("#"))
    fields = next(csv.reader([lines[start]], delimiter="\t"))
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(lines[start:], delimiter="\t"))
    require(
        len(rows) == len(lines[start + 1 :])
        and all(None not in r and None not in r.values() for r in rows),
        "Malformed SSSOM rows",
    )
    return lines[: start + 1], fields, list(zip(rows, lines[start + 1 :], strict=True))


def promoted_sssom(before, candidate, current):
    source.verify_complete(current)
    header, fields, prior = table(before)
    _, candidate_fields, generated = table(candidate)
    require(fields == candidate_fields, "Candidate columns differ")
    old = [r for r, _ in prior if r["subject_id"] == SUBJECT]
    target = [(r, line) for r, line in generated if r["subject_id"] == SUBJECT]
    require(len(old) == len(target) == 1, "Exactly one old and candidate stock row required")
    row, line = target[0]
    old = old[0]
    tokens = old["other"].split("|")
    require(len(tokens) == 7 and tokens.count(CAS_TOKEN) == 1, "Prior stock aliases differ")
    record = yaml.safe_load(current[OWNER])
    history = record["curation_history"][-1]
    expected_source = "|".join(
        ["MIM:" + e["source"] for e in record["ontology_mapping"]["evidence"] if e.get("source")]
        + ["MIM:curator=" + history["curator"]]
    )
    expected = dict(
        old,
        other="|".join(t for t in tokens if t != CAS_TOKEN),
        source=expected_source,
        mapping_date=history["timestamp"][:10],
        validation_method=OLD_STAMP,
    )
    require(
        old["validation_method"] == OLD_STAMP
        and old["object_id"] == IDENTITY
        and old["predicate_id"] == "skos:exactMatch"
        and row == expected,
        "Candidate stock row exceeds exact CAS/provenance scope",
    )
    projected = dict(row, validation_method="")
    line = "\t".join(projected[k] for k in fields) + "\n"
    output = "".join(header) + "".join(
        line if r["subject_id"] == SUBJECT else raw for r, raw in prior
    )
    lines = output.splitlines(keepends=True)
    date = newest_row_date(lines)
    require(date is not None, "Projected mapping date absent")
    return "".join(rewrite(lines, date)[0]).encode()


def generation_inputs(
    root: Path, bundle: Path, producer: Path, source_log: Path, proof: Path, manifest_sha256: str
):
    """Bind merged producer bytes and exact offline replay, with no ontology calls."""
    bound, saved, old = _captured_sources(root, source_log, proof)
    bundle, producer = checked_root(bundle), checked_root(producer)
    names = (
        "candidate.sssom.tsv",
        "suppressed_aliases.tsv",
        "candidate.sssom.tsv.manifest.json",
        "generation-receipt.json",
        "inputs-before.json",
        "inputs-after.json",
        "repository-context.json",
    )
    for name in names:
        bound[bundle / name] = regular(bundle / name)
    manifest = json.loads(bound[bundle / names[2]])
    receipt = json.loads(bound[bundle / "generation-receipt.json"])
    before, after = (
        json.loads(bound[bundle / n]) for n in ("inputs-before.json", "inputs-after.json")
    )
    context = json.loads(bound[bundle / "repository-context.json"])
    require(digest(bound[bundle / names[2]]) == manifest_sha256, "Candidate manifest hash differs")
    require(
        bound[bundle / "inputs-before.json"] == bound[bundle / "inputs-after.json"]
        and before == after
        and receipt["input_bytes_unchanged"] is True,
        "Generation input inventories differ",
    )
    require(
        receipt.get("scientific_approval_added") is False
        and receipt.get("supervisor_binding") is None,
        "Generation cannot confer approval",
    )
    require(
        manifest.get("schema_version") == 1
        and manifest.get("policy_version") == "owned-name-policy-v1"
        and manifest.get("external_sssom_validation") == "passed",
        "Native generation contract differs",
    )
    require(
        manifest["source_revisions"]["claw"] == PRODUCER == receipt["producer_revision"],
        "Wrong producer revision",
    )
    require(
        native.git(producer, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip() == PRODUCER
        and not native.git(producer, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"),
        "Producer is not clean and pinned",
    )
    for key, path in (("mim", root), ("claw", producer)):
        require(
            context[key]["path"] == str(path)
            and not context[key]["status"]
            and context[key]["revision"] == manifest["source_revisions"][key],
            "Generation checkpoint differs",
        )
    for name, field in (
        (names[0], "candidate_sha256"),
        (names[1], "sidecar_sha256"),
        (names[2], "native_generation_manifest_sha256"),
    ):
        require(
            digest(bound[bundle / name]) == receipt[field], "Generation artifact receipt differs"
        )
    require(
        receipt["input_manifest_sha256"] == digest(bound[bundle / "inputs-before.json"]),
        "Generation input receipt differs",
    )
    require(
        manifest["artifacts"]
        == [
            {
                "path": str(bundle / names[0]),
                "role": "sssom",
                "sha256": receipt["candidate_sha256"],
            },
            {
                "path": str(bundle / names[1]),
                "role": "suppressed_aliases",
                "sha256": receipt["sidecar_sha256"],
            },
        ],
        "Candidate pair differs",
    )
    producers = native.producer_paths(producer)
    code = {Path(p): value for p, value in manifest["producer_import_snapshot"].items()}
    require(set(code) == producers, "Producer dependency membership changed")
    blobs = {}
    for prefix in ("src", "scripts", "plugins"):
        blobs.update(native.git_blobs(producer, PRODUCER, prefix))
    for path in producers:
        data = regular(path)
        require(
            path in blobs and native.matches_blob(data, blobs[path]) and digest(data) == code[path],
            "Producer source changed",
        )
        bound[path] = data
    entry = producer / "scripts/build_mim_ingredient_sssom.py"
    require(
        receipt["executed_entry_source_sha256"] == receipt["producer_sha256"] == code[entry],
        "Executed entrypoint changed",
    )
    label_paths = {bundle / name for name in receipt["label_maps"]}
    require(
        label_paths == set(bundle.glob("label-input-*.json")), "Label receipt membership changed"
    )
    labels = {}
    for path in sorted(label_paths):
        require(path.parent == bundle, "Unsafe label receipt")
        bound[path] = regular(path)
        require(digest(bound[path]) == receipt["label_maps"][path.name], "Label capture changed")
        labels.update(json.loads(bound[path])["labels"])
    require(
        labels == manifest["canonical_label_resolution"],
        "Resolved labels differ from captured maps",
    )
    mapped = {
        path for path in ingredient_paths(root) if path.parent == root / "data/ingredients/mapped"
    }
    require(
        list(map(str, sorted(mapped))) == manifest["mapped_record_paths"],
        "Mapped input membership changed",
    )
    checkpoint = native.git_blobs(
        root, manifest["source_revisions"]["mim"], "data/ingredients/mapped"
    )
    require(set(checkpoint) == mapped, "Generation checkpoint owner membership differs")
    for path in mapped:
        require(
            native.matches_blob(bound[path], checkpoint[path]),
            "Generation owner differs from checkpoint",
        )
    declared = {Path(item["path"]): item["sha256"] for item in manifest["source_inputs"]}
    require(len(declared) == len(manifest["source_inputs"]), "Duplicate declared generation input")
    kgroot = checked_root(Path(context["kg_microbe"]["path"]))
    kg = kgroot / "mappings/kgmicrobe_unified_entity_mappings.sssom.tsv.gz"
    residual = producer / "workspace/reports/kg_microbe_residual_p25_categorized.json"
    prior = capture_anchors(proof)[SSSOM]
    require(
        manifest["prior_stamp_sources"] == [receipt["prior_stamps"]]
        and Path(receipt["prior_stamps"]) in {root / SSSOM, prior}
        and receipt["prior_sha256"] == BEFORE[SSSOM],
        "Prior-stamp source differs",
    )
    require(
        set(declared)
        == mapped | producers | {kg, residual, root / SSSOM, Path(receipt["prior_stamps"])},
        "Native input inventory differs",
    )
    absent = set()
    for path, expected in declared.items():
        if path == root / SSSOM:
            content = bound[prior]
        elif expected is None:
            require(not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink(), "Declared absent input appeared")
            absent.add(path)
            continue
        else:
            content = regular(path)
            bound[path] = content
        require(digest(content) == expected, "Native input bytes changed")
        if path not in producers:
            require(
                before[str(path)] == {"sha256": expected, "bytes": len(content)},
                "Harness input binding differs",
            )
    require(
        manifest["source_revisions"]["kg_microbe"] == context["kg_microbe"]["revision"],
        "KG revision receipt differs",
    )
    replay = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-I", "-c", _REPLAY, str(producer), str(bundle), str(prior), str(root)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=False,
    )
    require(replay.returncode == 0, "Exact native replay failed: " + replay.stderr[-4000:])
    result = json.loads(replay.stdout)
    require(result["rows"] == manifest["emitted_rows"], "Native replay row count differs")
    return bound, saved, old, result, producers, label_paths, absent


def promotion_manifest(
    before,
    canonical,
    current,
    source_log,
    *,
    generation_manifest_sha256,
    generation_receipt_sha256,
    source_receipt_sha256,
):
    source_log = bound_path(source_log)
    require(digest(before) == BEFORE[MANIFEST], "Prior policy manifest preimage differs")
    source.verify_complete(current)
    doc = json.loads(before)
    require(
        doc.get("schema_version") == 1 and doc.get("policy_version") == "owned-name-policy-v1",
        "Prior policy manifest contract differs",
    )
    require(
        doc["artifacts"] == {str(p): BEFORE[p] for p in (SSSOM, SIDECAR, BASELINE)}
        and doc["source_owner_sha256"][RECORD] == HISTORICAL_OWNER,
        "Prior policy artifact/historical owner binding differs",
    )
    require("stock_cas_removal_updates" not in doc, "Unexpected prior stock CAS update")
    doc["artifacts"][str(SSSOM)] = digest(canonical)
    doc["source_owner_sha256"][RECORD] = digest(current[OWNER])
    doc["stock_cas_removal_updates"] = [
        {
            "issue": 268,
            "scope": "Only the stock's mis-scoped CAS display assertion and explicitly reviewed provenance; fourteen chemistry-only historical owner pins, all other rows, policy decisions, form updates and registry history remain exact. No alias, mapping or role approval. "
            + STAMP_BASIS,
            "approval": APPROVAL,
            "prior_manifest_sha256": digest(before),
            "source_record": RECORD,
            "historical_owner_sha256": HISTORICAL_OWNER,
            "owner_before_sha256": source.META["owners"][RECORD]["sha256"],
            "owner_after_sha256": digest(current[OWNER]),
            "source_receipt": str(source_log),
            "source_receipt_sha256": source_receipt_sha256,
            "generation_manifest_sha256": generation_manifest_sha256,
            "generation_receipt_sha256": generation_receipt_sha256,
            "sssom_before_sha256": BEFORE[SSSOM],
            "sssom_after_sha256": digest(canonical),
            "sidecar_sha256": BEFORE[SIDECAR],
            "baseline_sha256": BEFORE[BASELINE],
        }
    ]
    return encoded(doc)


def promotion_backups(log):
    return {p: log.with_name(log.stem + ".before-" + p.name) for p in OUTPUTS}


def promote(
    root,
    bundle,
    producer,
    source_log,
    proof,
    log,
    *,
    generation_manifest_sha256,
    apply=False,
    _completed_inputs=False,
):
    root, bundle, producer = checked_root(root), checked_root(bundle), checked_root(producer)
    source_log, proof, log = bound_path(source_log), bound_path(proof), bound_path(log)
    inputs, saved, old, replay, producers, labels, absent = generation_inputs(
        root, bundle, producer, source_log, proof, generation_manifest_sha256
    )
    current = {p: inputs[root / p] for p in source.OWNERS}
    canonical = promoted_sssom(old[SSSOM], inputs[bundle / "candidate.sssom.tsv"], current)
    projection = promotion_manifest(
        old[MANIFEST],
        canonical,
        current,
        source_log,
        generation_manifest_sha256=generation_manifest_sha256,
        generation_receipt_sha256=digest(inputs[bundle / "generation-receipt.json"]),
        source_receipt_sha256=digest(inputs[source_log]),
    )
    outputs = {SSSOM: canonical, MANIFEST: projection}
    actual = {p: regular(root / p) for p in OUTPUTS}
    inputs.update({root / p: b for p, b in actual.items()})
    paths = ingredient_paths(root)
    result = {
        "phase": "promote-stock-cas",
        "approval": APPROVAL,
        "records": saved["records"],
        "source_log": str(source_log),
        "source_proof": str(proof),
        "bundle": str(bundle),
        "producer": str(producer),
        "generation_manifest_sha256": generation_manifest_sha256,
        "source_receipt_sha256": digest(inputs[source_log]),
        "source_proof_sha256": digest(inputs[proof]),
        "input_sha256": {
            str(p): digest(b) for p, b in inputs.items() if p not in {root / p for p in OUTPUTS}
        },
        "output_sha256": {str(p): digest(b) for p, b in outputs.items()},
        "sssom_before_sha256": BEFORE[SSSOM],
        "sssom_after_sha256": digest(canonical),
        "validation_stamp_override": {
            "native_candidate": OLD_STAMP,
            "canonical": "",
            "basis": STAMP_BASIS,
        },
        "native_replay": replay,
        "changed_subjects": [SUBJECT],
        "added_rows": 0,
        "removed_rows": 0,
    }

    def check():
        policy.validate_scope(root, inputs, paths)
        require(
            native.producer_paths(producer) == producers, "Producer dependency membership changed"
        )
        require(
            set(bundle.glob("label-input-*.json")) == labels, "Label receipt membership changed"
        )
        require(
            all(not p.exists() and not p.is_symlink() for p in absent),
            "Absent generation input appeared",
        )

    check()
    backups = promotion_backups(log)
    if actual == outputs:
        inputs[log] = policy.completed_receipt(log, result, root, changed=set(OUTPUTS))
        inputs.update(
            publication.completed_journal(root, log, json.loads(inputs[log]), previous=old)
        )
        for p, backup in backups.items():
            inputs[backup] = regular(backup)
            require(inputs[backup] == old[p], "Promotion beforeimage changed")
        check()
        return (
            (inputs, result)
            if _completed_inputs
            else {"applied": False, "changed": False, "approval": APPROVAL}
        )
    require(not _completed_inputs, "Completed promotion required")
    require(actual == old, "Partial or changed canonical promotion")
    return publication.publish(
        root,
        outputs,
        inputs,
        log,
        {backups[p]: old[p] for p in OUTPUTS},
        result,
        apply=apply,
        validate_scope=check,
    )


def verify_completed(root, promotion_log, *, source_log, source_proof):
    """Return fully verified current inputs and fifteen source records for native receipt23."""
    promotion_log = bound_path(promotion_log)
    saved = json.loads(regular(promotion_log))
    require(
        saved.get("phase") == "promote-stock-cas"
        and saved.get("state") == "complete"
        and saved.get("source_log") == str(bound_path(source_log))
        and saved.get("source_proof") == str(bound_path(source_proof)),
        "Completed promotion receipt required",
    )
    return promote(
        root,
        Path(saved["bundle"]),
        Path(saved["producer"]),
        source_log,
        source_proof,
        promotion_log,
        generation_manifest_sha256=saved["generation_manifest_sha256"],
        _completed_inputs=True,
    )


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=("capture-sources", "promote", "verify-completed"))
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=ROOT)
    parser.add_argument("--source-log", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-proof", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--log", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--bundle", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--producer", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--generation-manifest-sha256")
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
    mode.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.phase == "promote" and not all(
        (args.log, args.bundle, args.producer, args.generation_manifest_sha256)
    ):
        parser.error("promote requires log, bundle, producer and generation-manifest-sha256")
    if args.phase == "verify-completed" and (not args.log or args.apply):
        parser.error("verify-completed requires log and does not accept apply")
    from plugins.lock_manager import LockManager
    from plugins.repository_settings import RepositorySettings

    root = checked_root(args.root)
    target = RepositorySettings.from_environment().get_target("mediaingredientmech")
    require(target.path.resolve() == root, "Configured MIM root differs")
    target.open()
    with LockManager().lock("mediaingredientmech", "#871/#268 bounded stock CAS " + args.phase):
        if args.phase == "capture-sources":
            result = capture_sources(root, args.source_log, args.source_proof, apply=args.apply)
        elif args.phase == "promote":
            result = promote(
                root,
                args.bundle,
                args.producer,
                args.source_log,
                args.source_proof,
                args.log,
                generation_manifest_sha256=args.generation_manifest_sha256,
                apply=args.apply,
            )
        else:
            inputs, result = verify_completed(
                root, args.log, source_log=args.source_log, source_proof=args.source_proof
            )
            result = {
                **result,
                "verified_input_sha256": {str(p): digest(b) for p, b in inputs.items()},
            }
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Propose exact ontology groundings for the CultureMech residual.

`triage_culturemech_residual.py` leaves a RESIDUAL bucket: surface forms genuinely
absent from MIM. This tool searches them against CHEBI and reports only what it can
justify as an *exact* match -- the query equals the term's label or one of its exact
synonyms, case-insensitively. Nothing fuzzy is proposed, because a wrong grounding is
worse than an honest miss.

Every hit is then routed by whether MIM already holds the CURIE, which is the finding
that reshaped the #260 pass:

    SYNONYM_ONTO_EXISTING   a record already holds this CURIE. In MIM the `identifier`
                            IS the ontology CURIE, so minting a second record on it is a
                            duplicate by construction (the `Butane-1,4-diol` defect).
                            The fix is to add the surface form as a synonym.
    NEW_RECORD              the CURIE is free; a record can be created for it.

Read-only. Writes a review TSV; applies nothing. Groundings are applied by
`apply_culturemech_aliases.py` (synonyms) or the collection-edit path (new records).

Usage:
    python scripts/propose_residual_groundings.py --limit 10     # canary
    python scripts/propose_residual_groundings.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import time
import unicodedata
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from collections import defaultdict
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

import yaml
from oaklib.datamodels.search import SearchConfiguration, SearchProperty

_REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
TRIAGE = _REPO / "mappings" / "culturemech_residual_triage.tsv"
OUT = _REPO / "mappings" / "culturemech_residual_groundings.tsv"

# Shared with the triage fold: the codepoints recipe text uses and ontologies do not.
_UNICODE_FOLD = {
    "\u00b7": ".", "\u2022": ".", "\u00d7": "x", "\u2032": "'", "\u2019": "'",
    "\u2018": "'", "\u201c": '"', "\u201d": '"', "\u2013": "-", "\u2014": "-",
    "\u2212": "-", "\u3000": " ", "\uff65": ".",
}
_SUBSCRIPTS = str.maketrans("\u2080\u2081\u2082\u2083\u2084\u2085\u2086\u2087\u2088\u2089", "0123456789")

# Ontologies spell Greek letters out in ASCII -- CHEBI stores `beta-D-glucose` and
# `alpha-tocopherol` -- while recipe text uses the letter itself. Without this the two
# never meet: `beta-NAD` resolves to CHEBI:15846 and `β-NAD` resolves to nothing.
# Transliteration is applied for BOTH searching and comparison, so a surface form
# written either way reaches the same term.
_GREEK = {
    "\u03b1": "alpha", "\u03b2": "beta", "\u03b3": "gamma", "\u03b4": "delta",
    "\u03b5": "epsilon", "\u03b6": "zeta", "\u03b7": "eta", "\u03b8": "theta",
    "\u03ba": "kappa", "\u03bb": "lambda", "\u03c0": "pi", "\u03c1": "rho",
    "\u03c3": "sigma", "\u03c4": "tau", "\u03c9": "omega",
    "\u0391": "alpha", "\u0392": "beta", "\u0393": "gamma", "\u0394": "delta",
}



def _triage_module():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "triage", _REPO / "scripts" / "triage_culturemech_residual.py"
    )
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec.loader is not None
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def held_curies() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Map every CURIE MIM already holds as a record identifier -> preferred term."""
    held: dict[str, str] = {}
    for path in (_REPO / "data" / "ingredients").rglob("*.yaml"):
        data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("identifier"):
            held[str(data["identifier"])] = str(data.get("preferred_term") or "")
    if not held:
        raise SystemExit("no ingredient records found")
    return held


def mim_unmapped_rows(ingredient_type: str | None) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    """MIM's own UNMAPPED records as a worklist, newest-first by occurrence.

    Restricting to SINGLE_INGREDIENT matters. Of 269 UNMAPPED records, 102 are
    NAMED_MEDIUM -- whole culture media rather than ingredients, whose home is a
    `CultureMechReference` link (#489), not an ontology term; grounding one as an
    ingredient is a category error. Another 91 are UNDEFINED_MIXTURE, for which
    staying UNMAPPED is the correct outcome. Only the remainder is a grounding backlog.
    """
    rows = []
    for path in sorted((_REPO / "data" / "ingredients" / "unmapped").glob("*.yaml")):
        data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get("mapping_status") != "UNMAPPED":
            continue
        if ingredient_type and data.get("ingredient_type") != ingredient_type:
            continue
        stats = data.get("occurrence_statistics") or {}
        rows.append(
            {
                "bucket": "MIM_UNMAPPED",
                "label": str(data.get("preferred_term") or ""),
                "occurrences": str(stats.get("total_occurrences") or 0),
                "recipes": str(stats.get("media_count") or 0),
                "folded": "",
                "mim_identifier": str(data.get("identifier") or ""),
                "mim_label": str(data.get("preferred_term") or ""),
                "culturemech_reason": str(data.get("ingredient_type") or ""),
            }
        )
    if not rows:
        raise SystemExit("no matching UNMAPPED records found")
    return rows


def candidate_queries(label: str, fold_decoration) -> list[str]:
    """Conservative query variants: the label itself, and the label without decoration.

    Deliberately no hydrate stripping. `strip_hydrate_notation` truncates every
    spelled-out hydrate to a meaningless stem (#503), and more importantly a hydration
    state is identity (MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md Section 3) -- searching the anhydrous parent
    for a hydrate surface form is how a wrong grounding gets proposed.
    """
    queries = [label]
    # The codepoint-normalised form must be SEARCHED, not merely compared against:
    # oaklib returns nothing for a query carrying U+2032 PRIME or subscript digits, so
    # `[1,1<PRIME>-Biphenyl]-2-ol` found no hit even though CHEBI:17043 lists it verbatim.
    normalised = comparison_key(label)
    if normalised and normalised != label:
        queries.append(normalised)
    stripped = fold_decoration(label)
    if stripped and stripped.casefold() not in {q.casefold() for q in queries}:
        queries.append(stripped)
    return queries


def comparison_key(text: str) -> str:
    """Casefold a name for equality testing, without discarding chemistry.

    Only codepoint variation is folded -- recipe text writes U+2032 PRIME where CHEBI
    writes an ASCII apostrophe, and subscript digits where CHEBI writes ASCII, so
    `[1,1′-Biphenyl]-2-ol` and `[1,1'-biphenyl]-2-ol` are the same name. Punctuation
    is deliberately NOT stripped: that would make `EDTA` and `EDTA-2Na` compare equal.
    """
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text)
    for src, dst in _UNICODE_FOLD.items():
        text = text.replace(src, dst)
    for src, dst in _GREEK.items():
        text = text.replace(src, dst)
    return " ".join(text.translate(_SUBSCRIPTS).casefold().split())


# Ontologies whose alias space collides with ingredient names, so only a primary-label
# match is trustworthy. NCIT carries gene symbols and clinical concepts as synonyms: `B12`
# resolves through them to `TNFAIP1 wt Allele`, which would assert that vitamin B12 is a
# gene allele. Requiring the primary label removes that class of hit entirely.
LABEL_ONLY = frozenset({"NCIT", "MESH"})

# Below this length a name carries too little information for an exact match to mean
# anything: ontologies use short strings as formula and abbreviation synonyms across
# unrelated branches. `X` matched UBERON's "area X of ventral lateral nucleus" and `Ca`
# matched through a formula alias. Short labels are reported for curation, not proposed.
MIN_QUERY_LENGTH = 3

# An exact string match says nothing about whether the term denotes a *substance*.
# `Dissolve` matches NCIT:C64929 ("Dissolve", a procedure) and `Stock A` matches
# NCIT:C14643 -- both perfect label matches, neither an ingredient. That is the defect
# class of #356, where `X` was published as EXACT_MATCH against the 24th letter of the
# alphabet on a record with 101 occurrences. For ontologies broad enough to contain
# non-substances, require the term to descend from a substance root.
SUBSTANCE_ROOTS = {
    "NCIT": frozenset({"NCIT:C1908"}),  # Drug, Food, Chemical or Biomedical Material
}

# Prefixes whose accessions must be confirmed to round-trip before a proposal on them can
# be published. `promote_resolved_unmapped.canonical_label` performs the check and refuses
# `is_defining_ontology=false`.
ROUND_TRIP_CHECKED = frozenset({"MICRO"})


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def promoter():
    """The promotion helper, loaded lazily so the common path pays nothing for it."""
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "promote_resolved_unmapped", _REPO / "scripts" / "promote_resolved_unmapped.py"
    )
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec.loader is not None
    sys.modules["promote_resolved_unmapped"] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def denotes_a_substance(adapter, curie: str, prefix: str) -> bool:
    """Whether `curie` descends from one of its ontology's substance roots.

    Only consulted for ontologies in SUBSTANCE_ROOTS. Anything else is assumed to be
    substance-scoped already (CHEBI, FOODON) or narrow enough not to need it.
    """
    roots = SUBSTANCE_ROOTS.get(prefix)
    if not roots:
        return True
    try:
        from oaklib.datamodels.vocabulary import IS_A  # noqa: PLC0415

        ancestors = set(adapter.ancestors([curie], predicates=[IS_A]))
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - an unavailable hierarchy must not silently pass
        return False
    return bool(ancestors & roots)


def exact_hits(adapter, query: str, prefix: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Return (curie, label) for terms whose label or exact synonym equals `query`."""
    wanted = comparison_key(query)
    if len(wanted) < MIN_QUERY_LENGTH:
        return []
    if not wanted:
        return []
    # The default search config covers labels only. Most recipe surface forms are
    # synonyms rather than primary labels, so without ALIAS this finds almost nothing --
    # it reported 0 hits on the whole canary set.
    # force_case_insensitive matters as much as the properties. oaklib's search is
    # case-sensitive by default, so the lowercase normalised query missed every term
    # stored capitalised: `sodium glycerophosphate` did not reach NCIT:C120561
    # `Sodium Glycerophosphate`, an exact match this pass is supposed to find. The
    # near-match report surfaced it at similarity 1.000 with no risk flags, which is
    # what an exact match looks like when the exact pass has missed it.
    config = SearchConfiguration(
        properties=[SearchProperty.LABEL, SearchProperty.ALIAS], force_case_insensitive=True
    )
    trusted = getattr(adapter, "server_side_exact", False)
    out = []
    for curie in list(adapter.basic_search(query, config=config))[:25]:
        if not str(curie).startswith(f"{prefix}:"):
            continue
        label = adapter.label(curie) or ""
        if trusted:
            if denotes_a_substance(adapter, str(curie), prefix):
                out.append((str(curie), label))
            continue
        names = {comparison_key(label)}
        if prefix not in LABEL_ONLY:
            try:
                names.update(comparison_key(a) for a in adapter.entity_aliases(curie))
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - alias lookup is best-effort per term
                pass
        if wanted in names and denotes_a_substance(adapter, str(curie), prefix):
            out.append((str(curie), label))
    return out


class OlsAdapter:
    """Minimal exact-search backend for an ontology with no local semantic-sql build.

    MICRO ships as a 0-byte stub locally, and it is the ontology that actually models
    named growth media -- so without this every commercial broth and agar falls to
    NO_EXACT_HIT and looks like it needs minting when MAPPING_SEMANTICS Section 3 step 1
    would have grounded it.

    `queryFields` is not optional: without it OLS4's default search returned 0 hits for
    `MRS agar` and `nutrient broth`, both of which MICRO carries verbatim. The
    `ontology=` filter is also not trusted -- it leaks CHEBI rows -- so results are
    filtered on the CURIE prefix here.
    """

    BASE = "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/search"

    # OLS4 is asked for `exact=true` over `label,synonym`, so a returned term already
    # matched the query exactly on one of them. Re-checking client-side against the label
    # alone would discard every synonym match: `Christensen's urea agar` is an exact MICRO
    # synonym of `urea agar` (MICRO:0000643), and the check threw it away. That made the
    # whole MICRO pass label-only without saying so.
    server_side_exact = True

    def __init__(self, prefix: str, pause: float = 0.34) -> None:
        self.prefix = prefix
        self.pause = pause
        self._labels: dict[str, str] = {}

    def basic_search(self, query: str, config=None):  # noqa: ARG002 - adapter protocol
        params = urllib.parse.urlencode(
            {
                "q": query,
                "ontology": self.prefix.lower(),
                "queryFields": "label,synonym",
                "exact": "true",
                "rows": 10,
            }
        )
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            f"{self.BASE}?{params}", headers={"User-Agent": "MediaIngredientMech-grounding"}
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
                payload = json.load(response)
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
            print(f"  (OLS4 lookup failed for {query!r}: {exc})", file=sys.stderr)
            return []
        finally:
            time.sleep(self.pause)
        out = []
        for doc in payload.get("response", {}).get("docs", []):
            curie = str(doc.get("obo_id") or "")
            if curie.startswith(f"{self.prefix}:"):
                self._labels[curie] = str(doc.get("label") or "")
                out.append(curie)
        return out

    def label(self, curie: str) -> str:
        return self._labels.get(curie, "")

    def entity_aliases(self, curie: str):  # noqa: ARG002 - adapter protocol
        # Never consulted: `server_side_exact` short-circuits the client-side check.
        # Re-deriving real aliases would cost one request per term for no added trust.
        return [self._labels.get(curie, "")]


def recheck(report: Path, out: Path) -> int:
    """Re-apply the current guards to an existing proposals report.

    A full pass is expensive, so when a guard is added after a run the proposals it
    would now reject are removed here rather than by re-searching every label. Only
    rejects: a row this cannot re-validate is dropped, never upgraded, so recheck can
    never introduce a proposal the run did not make.
    """
    from oaklib import get_adapter  # noqa: PLC0415

    with report.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t"))
    adapters: dict[str, object] = {}
    kept, dropped = [], []
    for row in rows:
        curie, verdict = row.get("curie", ""), row.get("verdict", "")
        if verdict not in ("NEW_RECORD", "SYNONYM_ONTO_EXISTING") or not curie:
            kept.append(row)
            continue
        if len(comparison_key(row["label"])) < MIN_QUERY_LENGTH:
            dropped.append((row["label"], curie, "label shorter than MIN_QUERY_LENGTH"))
            continue
        prefix = curie.split(":", 1)[0]
        if prefix in ROUND_TRIP_CHECKED:
            # Resolve reviewed KGX exceptions from the pinned MICRO source;
            # other terms still require canonical ontology verification. A
            # lexical match alone cannot admit an unreviewed legacy IRI.
            try:
                promoter().canonical_label(curie)
            except SystemExit as exc:
                dropped.append((row["label"], curie, str(exc).split(" (IRI")[0]))
                continue
        if prefix in SUBSTANCE_ROOTS:
            if prefix not in adapters:
                adapters[prefix] = get_adapter(f"sqlite:obo:{prefix.lower()}")
            if not denotes_a_substance(adapters[prefix], curie, prefix):
                dropped.append((row["label"], curie, f"outside the {prefix} substance branch"))
                continue
        kept.append(row)

    with out.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(rows[0]), delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(kept)
    print(f"rechecked {len(rows)} rows; dropped {len(dropped)} proposal(s)")
    for label, curie, why in dropped:
        print(f"  - {label!r} -> {curie}: {why}")
    print(f"\nwrote {out}")
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--triage", type=Path, default=TRIAGE)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=OUT)
    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, help="only the N highest-occurrence labels (canary)")
    parser.add_argument("--bucket", default="RESIDUAL")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--sources",
        default="CHEBI,FOODON,ENVO,UBERON,BTO,NCIT",
        help="ontology prefixes to search, in preference order",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--ols-sources",
        default="MICRO",
        help="of --sources, which to query over OLS4 rather than a local build",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--from-mim-unmapped",
        action="store_true",
        help="work MIM's own UNMAPPED records instead of the CultureMech triage",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--ingredient-type",
        default="SINGLE_INGREDIENT",
        help="with --from-mim-unmapped, restrict to this ingredient_type ( for all)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--recheck",
        type=Path,
        help="re-apply current guards to an existing report instead of searching",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    if args.recheck:
        return recheck(args.recheck, args.out)

    if args.from_mim_unmapped:
        rows = mim_unmapped_rows(args.ingredient_type)
    elif not args.triage.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(
            f"triage report not found: {args.triage}\n"
            "Run: python scripts/triage_culturemech_residual.py"
        )
    else:
        with args.triage.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
            rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t") if r["bucket"] == args.bucket]
        if not rows:
            raise SystemExit(f"no {args.bucket} rows in {args.triage}")
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -int(r["occurrences"]))
    if args.limit:
        rows = rows[: args.limit]

    triage = _triage_module()
    held = held_curies()

    from oaklib import get_adapter

    # Preference order when more than one ontology carries the same exact name. It follows
    # the routing table in the map-media-ingredients skill: chemical identity first, then
    # food/biological material, then clinical reagent, then environmental and anatomical.
    # MICRO is absent because its local semantic-sql build is a 0-byte stub; named media
    # therefore stay in NO_EXACT_HIT rather than being silently routed elsewhere.
    sources = [s.strip().upper() for s in args.sources.split(",") if s.strip()]
    via_ols = {s.strip().upper() for s in args.ols_sources.split(",") if s.strip()}
    adapters = []
    for prefix in sources:
        if prefix in via_ols:
            adapters.append((prefix, OlsAdapter(prefix)))
            continue
        try:
            adapters.append((prefix, get_adapter(f"sqlite:obo:{prefix.lower()}")))
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - a missing build must not kill the run
            print(f"  (skipping {prefix}: {exc})", file=sys.stderr)
    if not adapters:
        raise SystemExit("no ontology adapters available")

    results = []
    for row in rows:
        label = row["label"]
        hits: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
        queries = candidate_queries(label, triage.fold)
        # Ontology preference has to dominate the query variants, not the other way round.
        # With queries outer, the RAW query found a match at a low-priority ontology before
        # the NORMALISED query ever reached a high-priority one -- oaklib's search is
        # case-sensitive, so `Air` missed ENVO's `air` and landed on NCIT while the
        # lowercase surface form `air` resolved to ENVO. The same substance took two
        # different ontologies based on nothing but capitalisation.
        for prefix, adapter in adapters:
            for query in queries:
                for curie, term_label in exact_hits(adapter, query, prefix):
                    hits.append((curie, term_label, query))
                if hits:
                    break
            if hits:
                # First ontology in preference order that answers exactly wins; a
                # lower-priority ontology carrying the same name adds no information.
                break
        if not hits:
            results.append({**row, "verdict": "NO_EXACT_HIT", "curie": "", "term_label": "", "matched_query": "", "holder": ""})
            continue
        curies = {h[0] for h in hits}
        if len(curies) > 1:
            results.append({**row, "verdict": "MULTIPLE_EXACT", "curie": "|".join(sorted(curies)),
                            "term_label": hits[0][1], "matched_query": hits[0][2], "holder": ""})
            continue
        curie, term_label, query = hits[0]
        holder = held.get(curie, "")
        verdict = "SYNONYM_ONTO_EXISTING" if holder else "NEW_RECORD"
        results.append({**row, "verdict": verdict, "curie": curie, "term_label": term_label,
                        "matched_query": query, "holder": holder})

    args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fields = list(rows[0]) + ["verdict", "curie", "term_label", "matched_query", "holder"]
    with args.out.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fields, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(results)

    counts: dict[str, list[int]] = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
    for r in results:
        counts[r["verdict"]][0] += 1
        counts[r["verdict"]][1] += int(r["occurrences"])
    print(f"{args.bucket} labels searched: {len(results)}")
    for verdict in sorted(counts):
        n, occ = counts[verdict]
        print(f"  {verdict:<22} {n:5d} labels  {occ:5d} occurrences")
    print(f"\nwrote {args.out}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Publish each record's CAS-RN into the SSSOM `other` column, so it reaches KGX.

Decided 2026-08-18: the knowledge-graph node should optimise for **how it
reads**, while the CAS-RN — the thing you actually order by — travels as a
**synonym** so it stays findable. This writes the second half.

## The propagation path, verified rather than assumed

kg-microbe's consolidator, for symmetric rows only:

    synonyms = [s for s in (subject_label, object_label) if s]
    if other:
        synonyms.extend(s.strip() for s in other.split("|") if s.strip())

(`scripts/consolidate_chemical_mappings.py`, the `predicate in symmetric`
branch.) So a pipe-separated entry in `other` becomes a synonym on the ontology
entity, and from there a KGX synonym. 1,366 rows already use the column this way
for chemical aliases; this adds the CAS to it.

Asymmetric rows are deliberately untouched: kg-microbe does not merge their
labels into the parent entity — that was the fix for the bug where
`find_chebi_by_name("Vermont Soil")` returned `ENVO:00001998 (soil)` — so a CAS
added there would be dropped, and adding it anyway would imply the parent is
purchasable under the child's CAS.

## Why `CAS:` prefixed

`9004-32-4` alone is a bare number that a synonym search cannot distinguish from
a catalogue code or a concentration. `CAS:9004-32-4` is self-describing and
matches how the curie_map already writes the prefix.

## What this does NOT do

It does not decide identity. A record's `chemical_properties.cas_rn` describes
the substance the record denotes; where the *purchasable* form differs, that
belongs in the `supplied_form` slot, and this script publishes
`supplied_form[].cas_rn` in preference when present — that is the number a lab
would order by.

    python scripts/publish_cas_as_synonym.py            # dry-run
    python scripts/publish_cas_as_synonym.py --apply
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import io
import sys
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
import yaml  # noqa: E402

MAPPED = ROOT / "data" / "curated" / "mapped_ingredients.yaml"
SSSOM = ROOT / "mappings" / "ingredient_mappings.sssom.tsv"
SYMMETRIC = {"skos:exactMatch", "skos:closeMatch"}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublishStats:
    added: int = 0
    already: int = 0
    skipped_asym: int = 0
    no_cas: int = 0


def cas_for(rec: dict) -> str | None:
    """The CAS a lab would order by, preferring the supplied form."""
    for sf in rec.get("supplied_form") or []:
        if (sf or {}).get("cas_rn"):
            return str(sf["cas_rn"]).strip()
    return str((rec.get("chemical_properties") or {}).get("cas_rn") or "").strip() or None


def publish_cas_rows(text: str, recs: Mapping[str, dict]) -> tuple[str, PublishStats]:
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    hdr_i = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith("subject_id"))
    reader = csv.DictReader(lines[hdr_i:], delimiter="\t")

    added, already, skipped_asym, no_cas = 0, 0, 0, 0
    body = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.DictWriter(
        body,
        fieldnames=reader.fieldnames,
        delimiter="\t",
        lineterminator="\n",
    )
    writer.writeheader()

    for row in reader:
        if row["predicate_id"] not in SYMMETRIC:
            skipped_asym += 1
            writer.writerow(row)
            continue
        rec = recs.get(row["subject_label"])
        cas = cas_for(rec) if rec else None
        if not cas:
            no_cas += 1
            writer.writerow(row)
            continue
        token = f"CAS:{cas}"
        parts = [p for p in row["other"].split("|") if p.strip()]
        if any(p.strip().casefold() == token.casefold() for p in parts):
            already += 1
            writer.writerow(row)
            continue
        parts.append(token)
        row["other"] = "|".join(parts)
        added += 1
        writer.writerow(row)

    return "".join(lines[:hdr_i]) + body.getvalue(), PublishStats(
        added=added,
        already=already,
        skipped_asym=skipped_asym,
        no_cas=no_cas,
    )


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter
    )
    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    recs = {
        str(r.get("preferred_term")): r
        for r in (yaml.safe_load(MAPPED.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}).get("ingredients", [])
    }

    out, stats = publish_cas_rows(SSSOM.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), recs)
    if args.apply and stats.added:
        SSSOM.write_text(out, encoding="utf-8")

    print(f"{'APPLIED' if args.apply else 'DRY RUN (re-run with --apply)'}\n")
    print(f"  CAS added to `other` on {stats.added} symmetric row(s)")
    print(f"  already present   : {stats.already}")
    print(f"  no CAS on record  : {stats.no_cas}")
    print(f"  asymmetric, skipped by design: {stats.skipped_asym}")
    kgx_message = (
        "\n  These become synonyms on the ontology entity in kg-microbe, " "and from there KGX."
    )
    print(kgx_message)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Project only the independently reviewed #1149 spelling from a native candidate.

The full regeneration changes unrelated historical provenance and row membership.
This bounded writer preserves all other canonical bytes, including confidence,
validation stamps and historical sources. Native receipts/review remain required.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path

from mediaingredientmech.curate.apply_receipt import reserve_receipt_outputs
from mediaingredientmech.curate.publication_guard import (
    FrozenFile,
    check_reserved,
    finish_receipt,
    no_alias,
    publish_validated,
)
from mediaingredientmech.ingredient_bundle_contract import content_sha256
from mediaingredientmech.source_alias_refresh import ADDED_SOURCE, ALIAS, OWNER, SOURCE, SUBJECT

CANONICAL_BEFORE = "d5f76fc404967477903fafc79eaba86ecfef9e2c391926ec08c3c1af4a5220b6"
PRODUCER = "76c1ebeea3fc7f80bf1abe044688f298f390cfac"


def rows(raw):
    return list(
        csv.DictReader(
            (s for s in raw.decode().splitlines() if not s.startswith("#")), delimiter="\t"
        )
    )


def project(before: bytes, candidate: bytes) -> tuple[bytes, dict]:
    if content_sha256(before) != CANONICAL_BEFORE:
        raise ValueError("Canonical baseline differs")
    selected = [r for r in rows(candidate) if r["subject_id"] == SUBJECT]
    old = [r for r in rows(before) if r["subject_id"] == SUBJECT]
    if len(selected) != 1 or len(old) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Ambiguous/missing subject rows")
    new, old = selected[0], old[0]
    allowed_native = {"other", "mapping_date", "source", "confidence"}
    if {k: v for k, v in old.items() if k not in allowed_native} != {
        k: v for k, v in new.items() if k not in allowed_native
    }:
        raise ValueError("Native candidate changes scoped identity or retained metadata")
    expected_tokens = old["other"].split("|") + [ALIAS]
    if len(set(expected_tokens)) != len(expected_tokens) or sorted(
        new["other"].split("|")
    ) != sorted(expected_tokens):
        raise ValueError("Native candidate changes more than the reviewed spelling")
    result = dict(old)
    result["other"] = "|".join(expected_tokens)
    result["mapping_date"] = new["mapping_date"]
    result["source"] += "|" + ADDED_SOURCE
    lines = before.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    header = next(s for s in lines if not s.startswith("#")).rstrip("\r\n").split("\t")
    replacements = 0
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.startswith(SUBJECT + "\t"):
            output = io.StringIO(newline="")
            csv.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=header, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n").writerow(
                result
            )
            lines[i] = output.getvalue()
            replacements += 1
    if replacements != 1:
        raise ValueError("Physical source row is ambiguous")
    return "".join(lines).encode(), {"before": old, "native_candidate": new, "after": result}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    parser.add_argument("--candidate", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--receipt-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    no_alias(args.root)
    no_alias(args.receipt_dir)
    root = args.root.absolute()
    canonical = FrozenFile.capture(root / SOURCE)
    captured = [FrozenFile.capture(p) for p in (root / OWNER, args.candidate, args.manifest)]
    owner, candidate_file, manifest_file = captured
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_file.content)
    candidate = candidate_file.content
    before = canonical.content
    owner_hash = content_sha256(owner.content)
    if (
        manifest["source_revisions"]["claw"] != PRODUCER
        or manifest["external_sssom_validation"] != "passed"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Unverified native producer")
    if not any(
        a["role"] == "sssom" and a["sha256"] == content_sha256(candidate)
        for a in manifest["artifacts"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Candidate is not bound to native manifest")
    if not any(
        a["path"] == str(root / OWNER) and a["sha256"] == owner_hash
        for a in manifest["source_inputs"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Generation does not bind current owner")
    after, audit = project(before, candidate)
    print(json.dumps({"subject": SUBJECT, "changed_rows": 1, "apply": args.apply}))
    if not args.apply:
        return
    log, backup_path = (
        args.receipt_dir / "projection.json",
        args.receipt_dir / "canonical-before.tsv",
    )
    with reserve_receipt_outputs(log, backup_paths=(backup_path,)) as (receipt, backup):

        def recheck():
            for item in captured:
                item.verify()
            check_reserved(receipt, log)
            check_reserved(backup, backup_path)

        canonical.verify()
        recheck()
        backup.write(before)
        backup.flush()
        published = publish_validated(canonical, lambda staged: staged.write_bytes(after), recheck)

        def final_check():
            published.verify()
            recheck()

        finish_receipt(
            receipt,
            log,
            {
                "issue": 1149,
                "approval": "NONE",
                "owner_sha256": owner_hash,
                "native_manifest_sha256": content_sha256(manifest_file.content),
                "native_candidate_sha256": content_sha256(candidate),
                "before_sha256": content_sha256(before),
                "after_before_header_sha256": content_sha256(after),
                "canonical_source": SOURCE,
                "row_projection": audit,
                "preservation": "Historical confidence, source vocabulary and validation stamp retained; no unrelated row adopted.",
            },
            final_check,
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
