def _form_require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError("Form projection: " + message)


def _form_sha(value):
    _form_require(isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value), "invalid SHA256")
    return value


def _form_member(root, name):
    path = safe_member(root, name)
    _form_require(not any(p.is_symlink() for p in (path, *path.parents)), "aliased proof input")
    _form_require(path.is_file(), "proof input is not a regular file")
    return path


def _verify_policy_projection(prior, before, current, context, *, registry=False, stock=False):
    """Verify one typed, caller-pinned update outside the selected cohort.

    Generation/source-receipt attribution is pinned, not independently replayed.
    Canonical and owner transitions are independently replayed from native receipts.
    The complete proof input inventory is returned for publication-time rechecking.
    """
    from mediaingredientmech.curie import mim_curie_for_stem
    from mediaingredientmech.validation.mapping_change_receipts import verify_mapping_chain

    _form_require(not (registry and stock), "typed contexts are mutually exclusive")
    expected_context = (
        StockCasRemovalContext
        if stock
        else RegistryCorrectionContext if registry else FormProjectionContext
    )
    _form_require(isinstance(context, expected_context), "explicit context and pin required")
    if registry or stock:
        _form_require(context.root.absolute() == context.root.resolve(), "aliased context root")
    root = context.root.resolve()
    if stock:
        _form_require(
            _form_member(root, "src/mediaingredientmech/ingredient_bundle_refresh.py").read_bytes()
            == _CODE,
            "loaded stock companion verifier differs",
        )
    _form_require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", context.baseline), "durable commit required")
    _form_require(
        content_sha256(current[POLICY_MANIFEST]) == _form_sha(context.manifest_sha256),
        "caller manifest pin differs",
    )
    old, new = (read_json(values[POLICY_MANIFEST]) for values in (before, current))
    fixed = {
        "schema_version",
        "policy_version",
        "approval",
        "scope",
        "decisions",
        "policy_evidence",
        "producer_revision",
        "generation_manifest_sha256",
        "generation_receipt_sha256",
        "source_receipt_sha256",
        "sssom_before_sha256",
        "baseline_before_sha256",
    }
    required = fixed | {"artifacts", "source_owner_sha256"}
    for doc in (old, new):
        _form_require(
            isinstance(doc, dict)
            and required <= set(doc)
            and set(doc)
            <= required
            | {
                "form_projection_updates",
                "registry_correction_updates",
                "stock_cas_removal_updates",
                "owned_name_suppression_updates",
                "source_alias_addition_updates",
            },
            "unknown manifest shape",
        )
        _form_require(
            type(doc["schema_version"]) is int
            and doc["schema_version"] == 1
            and doc["policy_version"] == "owned-name-policy-v1",
            "unknown policy/schema",
        )
    _form_require(all(old[k] == new[k] for k in fixed), "immutable policy/attribution changed")
    update_key = (
        "stock_cas_removal_updates"
        if stock
        else "registry_correction_updates" if registry else "form_projection_updates"
    )
    histories = {
        "form_projection_updates",
        "registry_correction_updates",
        "stock_cas_removal_updates",
        "owned_name_suppression_updates",
        "source_alias_addition_updates",
    }
    for other_key in histories - {update_key}:
        _form_require(
            (other_key in old) == (other_key in new)
            and (
                other_key not in old
                or (
                    isinstance(old[other_key], list)
                    and isinstance(new[other_key], list)
                    and canonical_json(old[other_key]) == canonical_json(new[other_key])
                )
            ),
            "other typed update history changed",
        )
    prefix, updates = old.get(update_key, []), new.get(update_key)
    _form_require(
        isinstance(prefix, list)
        and isinstance(updates, list)
        and len(updates) == len(prefix) + 1
        and updates[:-1] == prefix,
        "expected exactly one append with preserved history",
    )
    update = updates[-1]
    fields = {
        "issue",
        "scope",
        "approval",
        "prior_manifest_sha256",
        "source_record",
        "owner_before_sha256",
        "owner_after_sha256",
        "source_receipt",
        "source_receipt_sha256",
        "generation_manifest_sha256",
        "generation_receipt_sha256",
        "sssom_before_sha256",
        "sssom_after_sha256",
        "sidecar_sha256",
        "baseline_sha256",
    }
    if stock:
        fields.add("historical_owner_sha256")
    _form_require(isinstance(update, dict) and set(update) == fields, "unknown update shape")
    for name, value in update.items():
        if name.endswith("_sha256"):
            _form_sha(value)
    _form_require(
        type(update["issue"]) is int
        and update["issue"] > 0
        and isinstance(update["scope"], str)
        and bool(update["scope"])
        and isinstance(update["approval"], str)
        and update["approval"].startswith("NONE:")
        and isinstance(update["source_receipt"], str)
        and bool(update["source_receipt"]),
        "invalid attribution fields",
    )
    _form_require(
        update["prior_manifest_sha256"] == content_sha256(before[POLICY_MANIFEST]),
        "prior raw manifest hash differs",
    )
    source = read_json(before[prior["base_review"]])["source_sssom"]
    artifacts = {source, POLICY_SIDECAR, POLICY_BASELINE}
    for doc, values in ((old, before), (new, current)):
        _form_require(
            isinstance(doc["artifacts"], dict) and set(doc["artifacts"]) == artifacts,
            "artifact membership differs",
        )
        _form_require(
            all(doc["artifacts"][p] == content_sha256(values[p]) for p in artifacts),
            "artifact bytes differ",
        )
    for path in artifacts | {POLICY_MANIFEST}:
        _form_require(
            _form_member(root, path).read_bytes() == current[path],
            "context current artifact differs",
        )
    _form_require(
        before[POLICY_SIDECAR] == current[POLICY_SIDECAR]
        and before[POLICY_BASELINE] == current[POLICY_BASELINE],
        "policy sidecar/baseline changed",
    )
    for field, path in (("sidecar_sha256", POLICY_SIDECAR), ("baseline_sha256", POLICY_BASELINE)):
        _form_require(update[field] == content_sha256(current[path]), "update policy hash differs")
    for field, values in (("sssom_before_sha256", before), ("sssom_after_sha256", current)):
        _form_require(update[field] == content_sha256(values[source]), "canonical endpoint differs")
    owner = update["source_record"]
    _form_require(
        isinstance(owner, str)
        and owner.startswith("data/ingredients/mapped/")
        and owner.endswith(".yaml")
        and owner not in prior["record_inputs"],
        "owner is invalid or belongs to companion cohort",
    )
    current_owner = _form_member(root, owner).read_bytes()

    def historical(path):
        _form_member(root, path)
        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", context.baseline + ":" + path], cwd=root)

    for path in (source, POLICY_MANIFEST):
        _form_require(historical(path) == before[path], "baseline input bytes differ")
    old_owner = historical(owner)
    _form_require(
        update["owner_before_sha256"] == content_sha256(old_owner)
        and update["owner_after_sha256"] == content_sha256(current_owner),
        "actual owner endpoint differs",
    )
    old_owners, new_owners = old["source_owner_sha256"], new["source_owner_sha256"]
    _form_require(
        isinstance(old_owners, dict)
        and isinstance(new_owners, dict)
        and set(old_owners) == set(new_owners)
        and owner in old_owners,
        "owner inventory differs",
    )
    for values in (old_owners, new_owners):
        for digest in values.values():
            _form_sha(digest)
    expected_owners = dict(old_owners)
    historical_owner = update["historical_owner_sha256"] if stock else update["owner_before_sha256"]
    _form_require(expected_owners[owner] == historical_owner, "old owner map differs")
    expected_owners[owner] = update["owner_after_sha256"]
    _form_require(expected_owners == new_owners, "unaccounted owner change")
    proof = verify_mapping_chain(root)
    _form_require(
        proof["reviewed_sha256"] == update["sssom_after_sha256"], "current native chain differs"
    )
    matches = [r for r in proof["receipts"] if r["before_sha256"] == update["sssom_before_sha256"]]
    _form_require(
        len(matches) == 1 and matches[0] == proof["receipts"][-1],
        "update is not the exact final native suffix",
    )
    receipt = matches[0]
    _form_require(
        receipt["after_sha256"] == update["sssom_after_sha256"]
        and receipt["issue"]
        == f"https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/{update['issue']}",
        "native receipt endpoints/issue differ",
    )
    records = receipt["records"]
    registry_proof = None
    if stock:
        from mediaingredientmech.stock_cas_removal_refresh import verify_stock_transition

        registry_proof = verify_stock_transition(
            prior, before, current, context, update, proof, historical, _form_member
        )
    elif registry:
        from mediaingredientmech.registry_correction_refresh import verify_registry_transition

        registry_proof = verify_registry_transition(
            prior, before, current, context, update, proof, historical, _form_member
        )
    else:
        _form_require(
            len(records) == 1
            and records[0]["source_record"] == owner
            and records[0]["before_yaml_sha256"] == update["owner_before_sha256"]
            and records[0]["after_yaml_sha256"] == update["owner_after_sha256"]
            and records[0]["shape"] == "hydrate_parent_predicate",
            "native owner transition differs",
        )
    subject = mim_curie_for_stem(Path(owner).stem)
    _form_require(
        receipt["touched_subjects"] == [subject]
        and all(
            row["subject_id"] == subject
            for change in receipt["changes"]
            for row in (change["before"], change["after"])
            if row is not None
        ),
        "unaccounted native subject change",
    )
    inputs = dict(proof["input_hashes"])

    def bind_inputs(values):
        # A later capture must attest the bytes actually used by native replay.
        # Restoring historical bytes after replay cannot replace that proof.
        for name, expected in values.items():
            _form_require(
                name not in inputs or inputs[name] == expected,
                "conflicting proof input hash: " + name,
            )
            inputs[name] = expected

    if registry_proof is not None:
        bind_inputs(registry_proof["input_sha256"])
    bind_inputs({owner: content_sha256(current_owner)})
    bind_inputs({path: content_sha256(current[path]) for path in artifacts | {POLICY_MANIFEST}})
    for path in (
        "src/mediaingredientmech/ingredient_bundle_refresh.py",
        "src/mediaingredientmech/validation/mapping_change_receipts.py",
    ):
        bind_inputs({path: content_sha256(_form_member(root, path).read_bytes())})
    result = {
        "manifest_before_sha256": content_sha256(before[POLICY_MANIFEST]),
        "caller_pinned_manifest_sha256": context.manifest_sha256,
        "attribution_contract": "Exact caller-pinned attribution; generation/source receipts are not replayed here.",
        "native_transition_contract": "Full native receipt chain and durable-baseline/current owner bytes verified.",
        "baseline": context.baseline,
        "source_record": owner,
        "appended_update": update,
        "native_receipt": proof["receipt_paths"][-1],
        "native_receipt_sha256": proof["receipt_inputs"][proof["receipt_paths"][-1]],
        "receipt_paths": proof["receipt_paths"],
        "input_sha256": inputs,
        "scientific_approval_added": False,
    }
    if registry_proof is not None:
        result["stock_cas_transition" if stock else "registry_transition"] = registry_proof
    return result


def verify_form_projection(prior, before, current, context):
    """Retain the existing one-owner, typed form projection contract."""
    return _verify_policy_projection(prior, before, current, context)


def verify_registry_correction(prior, before, current, context):
    """Verify the distinct bounded CAS/node-cleanup successor contract."""
    return _verify_policy_projection(prior, before, current, context, registry=True)


def verify_stock_cas_removal(prior, before, current, context):
    """Verify the separately scoped stock-CAS removal and fifteen-owner cleanup."""
    return _verify_policy_projection(prior, before, current, context, stock=True)


def source_names(review):
    return {
        review["base_review"],
        review["claims_file"],
        *review["inputs"],
        *review["record_inputs"],
    }


def encode(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode()


def verify_unchanged_cohort(
    prior,
    before,
    current,
    old_contracts,
    new_contracts,
    *,
    form_projection=None,
    registry_correction=None,
    stock_cas_removal=None,
    owned_name_suppression=None,
    source_alias_addition=None,
):
    """Return a dependency-only successor and complete selected-claim evidence."""
    if (
        sum(
            x is not None
            for x in (
                form_projection,
                registry_correction,
                stock_cas_removal,
                owned_name_suppression,
                source_alias_addition,
            )
        )
        > 1
    ):
        raise ValueError("Typed projection contexts are mutually exclusive")
    if set(old_contracts) != set(CONTRACTS) or old_contracts != new_contracts:
        raise ValueError("Packaged schema/profile contract changed")
    if set(before) != source_names(prior) or set(current) != set(before):
        raise ValueError("Companion source coverage changed")
    _, old_loaded = reviewed_products(prior, before)
    old_base = read_json(before[prior["base_review"]])
    new_base = read_json(current[prior["base_review"]])
    source = old_base["source_sssom"]
    if new_base["source_sssom"] != source:
        raise ValueError("Original SSSOM source path changed")
    old_meta, old_fields, old_rows = _base_table(before[source])
    new_meta, new_fields, new_rows = _base_table(current[source])
    claims = read_json(before[prior["claims_file"]])["claims"]
    selected_old_decisions = []
    for claim in claims:
        if claim["kind"] != "mapping":
            continue
        row = {field: claim["payload"][field] for field in old_fields}
        if old_rows.count(row) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Selected original row is ambiguous")
        position = old_rows.index(row) + 1
        selected_old_decisions.append(
            next(d for d in old_base["decisions"] if d["source_position"] == position)
        )
    # Only the selected base decisions identify global evidence containers.
    # Other scope/claim evidence and every owner remain byte-immutable.
    evidence_containers = {d["review_evidence"] for d in selected_old_decisions}
    allowed = {prior["base_review"], source, *evidence_containers}
    changed = {p for p in before if before[p] != current[p]}
    projection = None
    if form_projection is not None and POLICY_MANIFEST not in changed:
        raise ValueError("Form projection requested without a changed policy manifest")
    if POLICY_MANIFEST in changed and form_projection is not None:
        projection = verify_form_projection(prior, before, current, form_projection)
        allowed.add(POLICY_MANIFEST)
    if registry_correction is not None and POLICY_MANIFEST not in changed:
        raise ValueError("Registry correction requested without a changed policy manifest")
    if POLICY_MANIFEST in changed and registry_correction is not None:
        projection = verify_registry_correction(prior, before, current, registry_correction)
        allowed.add(POLICY_MANIFEST)
    if stock_cas_removal is not None and POLICY_MANIFEST not in changed:
        raise ValueError("Stock CAS removal requested without a changed policy manifest")
    if POLICY_MANIFEST in changed and stock_cas_removal is not None:
        projection = verify_stock_cas_removal(prior, before, current, stock_cas_removal)
        allowed.add(POLICY_MANIFEST)
    if owned_name_suppression is not None:
        if POLICY_MANIFEST not in changed:
            raise ValueError("Owned-name suppression requested without a changed policy manifest")
        from mediaingredientmech.owned_name_suppression_refresh import verify_owned_name_suppression

        projection = verify_owned_name_suppression(prior, before, current, owned_name_suppression)
        allowed.update((POLICY_MANIFEST, POLICY_SIDECAR, POLICY_BASELINE))
    if source_alias_addition is not None:
        if POLICY_MANIFEST not in changed:
            raise ValueError("Source alias addition requested without a changed policy manifest")
        from mediaingredientmech.source_alias_refresh import verify_source_alias_addition

        projection = verify_source_alias_addition(prior, before, current, source_alias_addition)
        allowed.add(POLICY_MANIFEST)
    if changed - allowed:
        raise ValueError(
            "Non-global input or owner changed: " + ", ".join(sorted(changed - allowed))
        )
    for decision in prior["decisions"]:
        entries = [
            read_json(sources[decision["review_evidence"]])["entries"][decision["evidence_key"]]
            for sources in (before, current)
        ]
        if entries[0] != entries[1]:
            raise ValueError("Companion scientific evidence changed")
    mutable_base = {"source_sha256", "inputs", "record_inputs", "decisions"}
    if {k: v for k, v in old_base.items() if k not in mutable_base} != {
        k: v for k, v in new_base.items() if k not in mutable_base
    }:
        raise ValueError("Original review scope or contract changed")
    if old_fields != new_fields:
        raise ValueError("Original SSSOM column definitions changed")
    if {k: v for k, v in old_meta.items() if k not in DATE_FIELDS} != {
        k: v for k, v in new_meta.items() if k not in DATE_FIELDS
    }:
        raise ValueError("Original SSSOM semantic metadata changed")
    for metadata, rows in ((old_meta, old_rows), (new_meta, new_rows)):
        for key in DATE_FIELDS:
            value = str(metadata.get(key, ""))
            if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}", value):
                raise ValueError("Invalid SSSOM date/version")
            date.fromisoformat(value)
        if metadata["mapping_date"] != metadata["mapping_set_version"]:
            raise ValueError("SSSOM date/version disagree")
        row_dates = []
        for row in rows:
            value = row.get("mapping_date", "")
            if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}", value):
                raise ValueError("Invalid original row mapping_date")
            row_dates.append(date.fromisoformat(value))
        if date.fromisoformat(str(metadata["mapping_date"])) != max(row_dates):
            raise ValueError("SSSOM header date differs from newest row date (Rule G)")
    selected = []
    for claim in claims:
        if claim["kind"] != "mapping":
            continue
        row = {field: claim["payload"][field] for field in old_fields}
        if old_rows.count(row) != 1 or new_rows.count(row) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Selected complete original row changed or became ambiguous")
        positions = [old_rows.index(row) + 1, new_rows.index(row) + 1]
        decisions = [
            next(d for d in base["decisions"] if d["source_position"] == position)
            for base, position in zip((old_base, new_base), positions, strict=True)
        ]
        # A source insertion/removal/reorder can move an unchanged selected row
        # and its evidence entry. Compare the scientific decision separately
        # from those locators, then resolve each locator in its own snapshot.
        location_fields = {"source_position", "evidence_key"}
        scientific_decisions = [
            {key: value for key, value in decision.items() if key not in location_fields}
            for decision in decisions
        ]
        if (
            scientific_decisions[0] != scientific_decisions[1]
            or decisions[1]["disposition"] != "SUPPORTED"
        ):
            raise ValueError("Selected original scientific decision changed")
        entries = [
            read_json(sources[decision["review_evidence"]])["entries"][decision["evidence_key"]]
            for sources, decision in zip((before, current), decisions, strict=True)
        ]
        if entries[0] != entries[1]:
            raise ValueError("Selected original scientific evidence changed")
        selected.append(
            {
                "claim_id": claim["claim_id"],
                "original_row": row,
                "base_decision": decisions[0],
                "base_decision_locations": {
                    name: {key: decision[key] for key in sorted(location_fields)}
                    for name, decision in zip(("before", "after"), decisions, strict=True)
                },
                "base_evidence": entries[0],
            }
        )
    successor = deepcopy(prior)
    successor["base_review_sha256"] = content_sha256(current[prior["base_review"]])
    for name in allowed - {prior["base_review"]}:
        successor["inputs"][name] = content_sha256(current[name])
    _, new_loaded = reviewed_products(successor, current)
    if {k: v for k, v in old_loaded.items() if k != "metadata"} != {
        k: v for k, v in new_loaded.items() if k != "metadata"
    }:
        raise ValueError("Reconstructed companion payloads changed")
    audit = {
        "operation": "refresh_unchanged_companion_cohort",
        "scientific_approval_added": False,
        "claim_counts": dict(sorted(Counter(c["kind"] for c in claims).items())),
        "owner_hashes_unchanged": prior["record_inputs"],
        "claims_sha256_unchanged": prior["claims_sha256"],
        "companion_decisions_sha256_unchanged": content_sha256(canonical_json(prior["decisions"])),
        "selected_mapping_evidence_unchanged": selected,
        "semantic_metadata_unchanged": {k: v for k, v in old_meta.items() if k not in DATE_FIELDS},
        "columns_unchanged": old_fields,
        "header_date_changes": {
            k: {"before": str(old_meta[k]), "after": str(new_meta[k])} for k in sorted(DATE_FIELDS)
        },
        "contract_sha256_unchanged": {p: content_sha256(b) for p, b in old_contracts.items()},
        "dependency_changes": {
            p: {"before": content_sha256(before[p]), "after": content_sha256(current[p])}
            for p in sorted(changed)
        },
        "unchanged_input_sha256": {
            p: content_sha256(before[p]) for p in sorted(before.keys() - changed)
        },
        "native_historical_and_successor_payload_replay": "PASS; all claim payloads equal; only validated header dates differ",
    }
    if projection is not None:
        key = (
            "owned_name_suppression"
            if owned_name_suppression is not None
            else (
                "stock_cas_removal"
                if stock_cas_removal is not None
                else "registry_correction" if registry_correction is not None else "form_projection"
            )
        )
        if source_alias_addition is not None:
            key = "source_alias_addition"
        audit[key] = projection
    return successor, audit


def validate_destinations(paths):
    """Validate ordered paths before any mapping can discard duplicate keys."""
    if len({p.resolve() for p in paths}) != len(paths):
        raise ValueError("Output paths collide")


def publish_new_files(outputs, verify_snapshot):
    """Retain parent/leaf handles and refuse replaced publication destinations."""
    validate_destinations([p for p, _ in outputs])
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        parents: dict[Path, tuple[int, tuple[int, int]]] = {}
        reserved: list[tuple[Path, BinaryIO, tuple[int, int], int]] = []

        def still_owned(path, identity, parent_fd):
            try:
                actual = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=parent_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                return False
            return (actual.st_dev, actual.st_ino) == identity

        def verify_parents():
            for parent, (_, identity) in parents.items():
                if parent.absolute() != parent.resolve():
                    raise ValueError("Output parent became aliased: " + str(parent))
                try:
                    actual = parent.lstat()
                except FileNotFoundError as error:
                    raise ValueError("Output parent disappeared: " + str(parent)) from error
                if (actual.st_dev, actual.st_ino) != identity:
                    raise ValueError("Output parent changed: " + str(parent))

        def verify_reservations():
            verify_parents()
            for path, _, identity, parent_fd in reserved:
                if not still_owned(path, identity, parent_fd):
                    raise ValueError("Output reservation changed: " + str(path))

        try:
            for path, _ in outputs:
                parent = path.parent
                if parent not in parents:
                    if parent.absolute() != parent.resolve():
                        raise ValueError("Output parent is aliased: " + str(parent))
                    intended = parent.lstat()
                    intended_identity = (intended.st_dev, intended.st_ino)
                    parent_fd = os.open(parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
                    stack.callback(os.close, parent_fd)
                    status = os.fstat(parent_fd)
                    if (status.st_dev, status.st_ino) != intended_identity:
                        raise ValueError("Output parent changed during acquisition: " + str(parent))
                    parents[parent] = (parent_fd, intended_identity)
                parent_fd, _ = parents[parent]
                verify_parents()
                fd = os.open(
                    path.name,
                    os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                    0o666,
                    dir_fd=parent_fd,
                )
                handle = stack.enter_context(os.fdopen(fd, "wb"))
                status = os.fstat(handle.fileno())
                reserved.append((path, handle, (status.st_dev, status.st_ino), parent_fd))
            verify_snapshot()
            verify_reservations()
            for (_, output_handle, _, _), (_, content) in zip(reserved, outputs, strict=True):
                # Never reopen a pathname after reservation: even a concurrent
                # replacement cannot redirect this write to another inode.
                verify_reservations()
                output_handle.write(content)
                output_handle.flush()
            verify_reservations()
        except BaseException:
            # Cleanup uses the original directory even when its pathname changed.
            # Preserve another writer's replacement entry in either directory.
            for path, _, identity, parent_fd in reserved:
                if still_owned(path, identity, parent_fd):
                    os.unlink(path.name, dir_fd=parent_fd)
            raise


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    parser.add_argument(
        "--baseline", required=True, help="Git commit containing the prior review and its inputs"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--prior-review",
        type=Path,
        required=True,
        help="Repository-relative preserved prior review",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True, help="New successor review path")
    parser.add_argument("--receipt", type=Path, required=True, help="New verification receipt path")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--prior-copy", type=Path, required=True, help="New exact prior-review copy path"
    )
    projection_options = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    projection_options.add_argument(
        "--form-projection-manifest-sha256",
        help="Explicit reviewed successor manifest pin; native owner/receipt checks still apply",
    )
    projection_options.add_argument(
        "--registry-correction-manifest-sha256",
        help="Explicit #753/#870 registry successor pin; preserves all companion science",
    )
    projection_options.add_argument(
        "--stock-cas-removal-manifest-sha256",
        help="Explicit #268/#871 stock-CAS successor pin; preserves all companion science",
    )
    projection_options.add_argument(
        "--owned-name-suppression-manifest-sha256",
        help="Explicit #669 export-only successor pin; sources and companion science stay exact",
    )
    projection_options.add_argument(
        "--source-alias-addition-manifest-sha256",
        help="Explicit #1149 source-alias successor pin; no inherited scientific approval",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if (
        args.registry_correction_manifest_sha256 is not None
        or args.stock_cas_removal_manifest_sha256 is not None
        or args.owned_name_suppression_manifest_sha256 is not None
        or args.source_alias_addition_manifest_sha256 is not None
    ):
        _form_require(args.root.absolute() == args.root.resolve(), "aliased context root")
    root = args.root.resolve()
    destinations = [root / args.output, root / args.receipt, root / args.prior_copy]
    validate_destinations(destinations)
    prior_path = args.prior_review.as_posix()
    old_bytes = safe_member(root, prior_path).read_bytes()
    prior = read_json(old_bytes)
    baseline = (
        subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", "rev-parse", "--verify", "--end-of-options", args.baseline + "^{commit}"],
            cwd=root,
        )
        .decode()
        .strip()
    )

    def historical(name):
        safe_member(root, name)
        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", baseline + ":" + name], cwd=root)

    if historical(prior_path) != old_bytes:
        raise ValueError("Historical companion review changed")
    # Validate the entire current base review before considering the selected cohort.
    loaded = load_review(root, Path(prior["base_review"]))
    before = {name: historical(name) for name in source_names(prior)}
    current = {name: safe_member(root, name).read_bytes() for name in before}
    old_contracts = {name: historical(name) for name in CONTRACTS}
    new_contracts = {name: (root / name).read_bytes() for name in CONTRACTS}
    for name in (PROFILE_NAME, SCHEMA_NAME):
        if contract_resource(name) != new_contracts["src/mediaingredientmech/profiles/" + name]:
            raise ValueError("Loaded package differs from current schema/profile")
    form_projection = (
        FormProjectionContext(root, baseline, args.form_projection_manifest_sha256)
        if args.form_projection_manifest_sha256 is not None
        else None
    )
    registry_correction = (
        RegistryCorrectionContext(root, baseline, args.registry_correction_manifest_sha256)
        if args.registry_correction_manifest_sha256 is not None
        else None
    )
    stock_cas_removal = (
        StockCasRemovalContext(root, baseline, args.stock_cas_removal_manifest_sha256)
        if args.stock_cas_removal_manifest_sha256 is not None
        else None
    )
    owned_name_suppression = (
        OwnedNameSuppressionContext(root, baseline, args.owned_name_suppression_manifest_sha256)
        if args.owned_name_suppression_manifest_sha256 is not None
        else None
    )
    source_alias_addition = (
        SourceAliasAdditionContext(root, baseline, args.source_alias_addition_manifest_sha256)
        if args.source_alias_addition_manifest_sha256 is not None
        else None
    )
    successor, audit = verify_unchanged_cohort(
        prior,
        before,
        current,
        old_contracts,
        new_contracts,
        form_projection=form_projection,
        registry_correction=registry_correction,
        stock_cas_removal=stock_cas_removal,
        owned_name_suppression=owned_name_suppression,
        source_alias_addition=source_alias_addition,
    )
    new_bytes = encode(successor)
    audit.update(
        {
            "historical_commit": baseline,
            "requested_baseline": args.baseline,
            "execution_head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=root)
            .decode()
            .strip(),
            "producer_sha256": content_sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
            "prior_review": prior_path,
            "prior_review_sha256": content_sha256(old_bytes),
            "successor_review": str(args.output),
            "successor_review_sha256": content_sha256(new_bytes),
            "current_full_base_review_validation": "PASS",
        }
    )
    snapshots = {root / p: content_sha256(b) for p, b in (current | new_contracts).items()}
    snapshots[root / prior_path] = content_sha256(old_bytes)
    snapshots.update(loaded["input_snapshot"])
    proof_key = (
        "owned_name_suppression"
        if owned_name_suppression is not None
        else (
            "stock_cas_removal"
            if stock_cas_removal is not None
            else "registry_correction" if registry_correction is not None else "form_projection"
        )
    )
    if source_alias_addition is not None:
        proof_key = "source_alias_addition"
    owned_name_source_roles: set[str] = set()
    if proof_key == "owned_name_suppression" and proof_key in audit:
        from mediaingredientmech.owned_name_suppression_refresh import recheck_inventory

        # #1132: the CLI also knows the prior companion and loaded review inputs.
        owned_name_source_roles = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in snapshots}
        recheck_inventory(root, audit[proof_key], owned_name_source_roles)
    if proof_key in audit:
        for path, expected in audit[proof_key]["input_sha256"].items():
            member = _form_member(root, path)
            if member in snapshots and snapshots[member] != expected:
                raise ValueError("Projection proof conflicts with captured input: " + path)
            snapshots[member] = expected
    outputs = list(zip(destinations, (new_bytes, encode(audit), old_bytes), strict=True))
    if any(p.resolve() in {s.resolve() for s in snapshots} for p, _ in outputs):
        raise ValueError("Output collides with a source input")

    def verify_snapshot():
        if proof_key in audit:
            from mediaingredientmech.validation.mapping_change_receipts import receipt_paths

            if receipt_paths(root) != audit[proof_key]["receipt_paths"]:
                raise ValueError("Projection receipt inventory changed during verification")
            for name in audit[proof_key]["input_sha256"]:
                _form_member(root, name)
            if proof_key in {
                "registry_correction",
                "stock_cas_removal",
                "owned_name_suppression",
                "source_alias_addition",
            }:
                from mediaingredientmech.registry_correction_refresh import receipt_inventory

                if receipt_inventory(root) != set(audit[proof_key]["receipt_paths"]):
                    raise ValueError("Registry receipt inventory changed during verification")
        if proof_key == "owned_name_suppression" and proof_key in audit:
            from mediaingredientmech.owned_name_suppression_refresh import recheck_inventory

            recheck_inventory(root, audit[proof_key], owned_name_source_roles)
        for path, expected in snapshots.items():
            if content_sha256(path.read_bytes()) != expected:
                raise ValueError("Input changed during verification: " + str(path))

    publish_new_files(outputs, verify_snapshot)
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "successor": str(args.output),
                "sha256": content_sha256(new_bytes),
                "claim_counts": audit["claim_counts"],
                "owners": len(prior["record_inputs"]),
            }
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError("Owned-name suppression: " + message)


def member(root, name):
    path = safe_member(root, name)
    require(path == path.resolve(), "aliased proof path: " + name)
    require(
        all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (path, *path.parents)),
        "symlink proof path: " + name,
    )
    require(path.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(path.stat().st_mode), "non-regular proof: " + name)
    return path


def _shape(value, kind):
    schema = {"$ref": "#/$defs/" + kind, "$defs": _SCHEMA["$defs"]}
    errors = sorted(Draft202012Validator(schema).iter_errors(value), key=lambda e: str(e.path))
    require(not errors, "invalid " + kind + " shape" + (": " + errors[0].message if errors else ""))
    require(type(value["schema_version"]) is int, "schema version must be an integer")
    if "issue" in value:
        require(type(value["issue"]) is int, "issue must be an integer")
    if kind == "plan":
        require(type(value["receipt_sequence"]) is int, "receipt sequence must be an integer")
    if kind == "update":
        require(
            type(value["mapping_receipt"]["sequence"]) is int
            and type(value["historical_checkpoint"]["sequence"]) is int
            and all(type(n) is int for n in value["historical_checkpoint"]["bridge_sequences"]),
            "receipt/checkpoint sequence must be an integer",
        )


def _tree(root, baseline):
    raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "-z", baseline], cwd=root)
    result = {}
    for item in raw.split(b"\0"):
        if not item:
            continue
        metadata, name = item.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, kind, oid = metadata.decode().split()
        result[name.decode()] = (mode, kind, oid)
    return result


def _historical_equal(tree, name, raw):
    expected = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
    require(
        name in tree
        and tree[name][0] in {"100644", "100755"}
        and tree[name][1] == "blob"
        and tree[name][2] == expected,
        "durable baseline bytes differ: " + name,
    )


def source_inventory(root):
    """Ignored-inclusive YAML membership; reject directory aliases before walking."""
    result = {}
    for folder in ("data/ingredients", "data/curated"):
        base = root / folder
        require(base.is_dir() and base == base.resolve(), "aliased source directory")
        found: list[str] = []
        for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(base, followlinks=False):
            for name in (*dirs, *files):
                path = Path(directory) / name
                require(not path.is_symlink(), "aliased source inventory member")
            found.extend(
                (Path(directory) / name).relative_to(root).as_posix()
                for name in files
                if Path(name).suffix in {".yaml", ".yml"}
            )
        result[folder] = sorted(found)
    return result


def recheck_inventory(root, proof, additional_roles=()):
    """Repeat both exhaustive memberships after publication has reserved outputs."""
    require(
        source_inventory(root) == proof["source_paths"],
        "source inventory changed during verification",
    )
    require(
        receipt_inventory(root) == set(proof["receipt_paths"]),
        "receipt inventory changed during verification",
    )
    log = proof["appended_update"]["publication_log"]
    _publication_log_path(root, log, (proof["input_sha256"].keys() - {log}) | set(additional_roles))


def _publication_log_path(root, name, other_roles):
    """#1132: a completed log cannot reuse another proof role or its inode."""
    require(name not in other_roles, "publication log reuses another proof role: " + name)
    path = member(root, name)
    for other in other_roles:
        require(
            not path.samefile(member(root, other)),
            "publication log aliases another proof role: " + other,
        )
    return path


def _table(raw):
    stream = io.StringIO(raw.decode(), newline="")
    reader = csv.DictReader(stream, delimiter="\t")
    rows = list(reader)
    require(reader.fieldnames is not None, "missing TSV header")
    require(all(None not in r and None not in r.values() for r in rows), "ragged TSV")
    return reader.fieldnames, rows


def source_reference(pair, before_sha):
    row = pair["before_row"]
    return (
        f"{SSSOM_SOURCE}#source_position={pair['source_position']}"
        f"&subject_id={row['subject_id']}&predicate_id={row['predicate_id']}"
        f"&object_id={row['object_id']}&field=other@sha256={before_sha}"
    )


def expected_record(pair, plan_ref):
    """Truthful export-only maker input; it asserts no fabricated YAML event."""
    return {
        "source_record": pair["source_owner"]["path"],
        "shape": "export_only_owned_name_suppression",
        "before_yaml_sha256": pair["source_owner"]["sha256"],
        "after_yaml_sha256": pair["source_owner"]["sha256"],
        "change": f"SUPPRESS {pair['baseline_row']['token']} from SSSOM other only; source YAML unchanged; no identity, role or release approval.",
        "verification": f"Owned-name export policy #669; preferred-name credits and prior-only provenance are frozen in {plan_ref['path']} sha256={plan_ref['sha256']}.",
    }


def _pairs(plan, old, new, source_bytes):
    baseline_fields, obligations = _table(old[BASELINE])
    require(
        baseline_fields == ["subject_id", "token", "owned_by", "disposition"],
        "baseline columns differ",
    )
    require(
        [p["baseline_row"] for p in plan["pairs"]] == obligations,
        "plan differs from complete baseline",
    )
    require(
        new[BASELINE] == old[BASELINE].splitlines(keepends=True)[0], "baseline retirement differs"
    )
    _, fields, old_rows = _base_table(old[SSSOM_SOURCE])
    _, new_fields, new_rows = _base_table(new[SSSOM_SOURCE])
    require(
        fields == new_fields and len(old_rows) == len(new_rows),
        "canonical row/column count differs",
    )
    records = {
        mim_curie_for_stem(Path(name).stem): _load_yaml(raw.decode())
        for name, raw in source_bytes.items()
        if Path(name).parent.as_posix() == "data/ingredients/mapped" and name.endswith(".yaml")
    }
    paths = {
        mim_curie_for_stem(Path(name).stem): name
        for name in source_bytes
        if Path(name).parent.as_posix() == "data/ingredients/mapped" and name.endswith(".yaml")
    }
    require(
        len(records)
        == sum(
            Path(name).parent.as_posix() == "data/ingredients/mapped" and name.endswith(".yaml")
            for name in source_bytes
        ),
        "ambiguous mapped source subjects",
    )
    owners = preferred_term_owners(records)
    label_rows = list(
        csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(source_bytes["docs/data/label_index.csv"].decode()))
    )
    selected = {}
    pair_keys = set()
    for pair in plan["pairs"]:
        position = pair["source_position"]
        require(type(position) is int and 1 <= position <= len(old_rows), "invalid source position")
        row = old_rows[position - 1]
        subject, token = pair["baseline_row"]["subject_id"], pair["baseline_row"]["token"]
        key = token.strip().casefold()
        require(
            (subject, key) not in pair_keys and position not in selected,
            "duplicate planned pair/position",
        )
        pair_keys.add((subject, key))
        require(
            pair["token_key"] == key and row == pair["before_row"] and row["subject_id"] == subject,
            "stale pair payload",
        )
        require(
            pair["selector"]
            == {
                **{k: row[k] for k in ("subject_id", "predicate_id", "object_id")},
                "field": "other",
            },
            "pair selector differs",
        )
        require(subject in paths, "unresolved subject owner")
        require(
            pair["source_owner"]
            == {"path": paths[subject], "sha256": content_sha256(source_bytes[paths[subject]])},
            "source owner differs",
        )
        credited = owners.get(key, frozenset())
        require(credited and subject not in credited, "token is not owned by another record")
        require(all(owner in paths for owner in credited), "unresolved credited owner")
        expected = [
            {
                "subject_id": owner,
                "path": paths[owner],
                "sha256": content_sha256(source_bytes[paths[owner]]),
            }
            for owner in sorted(credited)
        ]
        require(pair["credited_owners"] == expected, "native credited owner set differs")
        # owned_by is historical display text only: it neither selects nor parses credits.
        hits = [r for r in label_rows if r["label"].strip().casefold() == key]
        credited_ids = {str(records[owner].get("identifier", "")) for owner in credited}
        require(
            hits
            and hits[0]["match_type"] == "preferred_term"
            and hits[0]["identifier"] in credited_ids,
            "preferred owner is not first in label index",
        )
        aliases = records[subject].get("synonyms", []) or []
        require(
            not any(str(x.get("synonym_text") or "").strip().casefold() == key for x in aliases),
            "fresh YAML origin requires new scope",
        )
        matches = [
            (i, value)
            for i, value in enumerate(row["other"].split("|"))
            if value.strip().casefold() == key
        ]
        require(len(matches) == 1 and matches[0][1] == token, "planned raw token differs")
        result = "|".join(
            value for i, value in enumerate(row["other"].split("|")) if i != matches[0][0]
        )
        require(result == pair["after_other"], "other projection differs")
        require(
            pair["source_ref"] == source_reference(pair, plan["artifacts_before"][SSSOM_SOURCE]),
            "prior-only provenance differs",
        )
        for i, other in enumerate(old_rows, 1):
            require(
                i == position
                or other["subject_id"] != subject
                or not any(t.strip().casefold() == key for t in other["other"].split("|")),
                "selected alias occurs on another old row",
            )
        for other in new_rows:
            require(
                other["subject_id"] != subject
                or not any(t.strip().casefold() == key for t in other["other"].split("|")),
                "selected alias remains published",
            )
        selected[position] = pair
    expected_rows = deepcopy(old_rows)
    for position, pair in selected.items():
        expected_rows[position - 1]["other"] = pair["after_other"]
    require(expected_rows == new_rows, "unrelated canonical cell changed")
    old_lines, new_lines = old[SSSOM_SOURCE].splitlines(keepends=True), new[
        SSSOM_SOURCE
    ].splitlines(keepends=True)
    require(len(old_lines) == len(new_lines), "raw canonical layout differs")
    data_position = -1
    for before_line, after_line in zip(old_lines, new_lines, strict=True):
        if before_line.startswith(b"#"):
            require(before_line == after_line, "canonical header changed")
            continue
        data_position += 1
        if data_position not in selected:
            require(before_line == after_line, "unselected raw row changed")
        else:
            cells = before_line.rstrip(b"\r\n").split(b"\t")
            require(len(cells) == len(fields), "unexpected quoting in planned raw row")
            cells[fields.index("other")] = selected[data_position]["after_other"].encode()
            ending = before_line[len(before_line.rstrip(b"\r\n")) :]
            require(b"\t".join(cells) + ending == after_line, "raw row exceeds exact other cell")
    return old_rows, new_rows, selected


def _sidecar(plan, old, new):
    old_fields, old_rows = _table(old[SIDECAR])
    fields, rows = _table(new[SIDECAR])
    require(tuple(fields) == tuple(old_fields) == _SIDECAR_FIELDS, "sidecar header differs")
    require(
        old[SIDECAR].splitlines(keepends=True)[0] == new[SIDECAR].splitlines(keepends=True)[0],
        "sidecar raw header changed",
    )

    def keyed(values):
        result = {(r["subject_id"], r["token_key"]): r for r in values}
        require(len(result) == len(values), "duplicate sidecar pair")
        return result

    expected = keyed(old_rows)
    for pair in plan["pairs"]:
        row = {
            "subject_id": pair["before_row"]["subject_id"],
            "token_key": pair["token_key"],
            "token": pair["baseline_row"]["token"],
            "disposition": "SUPPRESS",
        }
        for name, value in {
            "owner_subject_ids": [o["subject_id"] for o in pair["credited_owners"]],
            "input_surfaces": ["prior_sssom"],
            "source_refs": [pair["source_ref"]],
            "evidence_refs": [plan["policy_evidence"]],
        }.items():
            row[name] = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        key = (row["subject_id"], row["token_key"])
        require(key not in expected, "selected pair already suppressed")
        expected[key] = row
    require(keyed(rows) == expected, "sidecar changed historical rows or scoped additions")
    # Native rendering may interleave the entries, but not rewrite their raw bytes.
    old_raw, new_raw = (
        old[SIDECAR].splitlines(keepends=True)[1:],
        new[SIDECAR].splitlines(keepends=True)[1:],
    )
    require(all(new_raw.count(line) == 1 for line in old_raw), "historical raw sidecar row changed")


def _continued_form_evidence(old, new, position, owner_hash, proof, historical_read):
    """#1133: derive provenance for an existing authority, never extend its science."""
    form = old.get("basis", {}).get("form_followup")
    if form is None:
        require(old == new, "unrelated base evidence changed")
        return
    authority = read_json(historical_read(form["file"]))
    checkpoint = authority["checkpoint"]
    sequence = checkpoint["sequence"]
    require(
        type(sequence) is int and 1 <= sequence < len(proof["receipts"]),
        "form checkpoint must precede the new receipt",
    )
    link = proof["receipts"][sequence - 1]
    path = proof["receipt_paths"][sequence - 1]
    require(
        checkpoint
        == {
            "sequence": sequence,
            "path": path,
            "sha256": proof["receipt_inputs"][path],
            "after_sha256": link["after_sha256"],
        },
        "form checkpoint differs from native replay",
    )
    claims = [c for c in authority["decisions"] if c["claim_kind"] == form["claim_kind"]]
    require(len(claims) == 1, "form authority claim is ambiguous")
    claim = claims[0]
    row = proof["state"][position - 1]
    require(
        claim["mapping"] == row
        and claim["row_sha256"] == old["row_sha256"] == content_sha256(canonical_json(row))
        and authority["owner_record"] == old["owner_record"]
        and authority["owner_record_sha256"] == old["owner_record_sha256"] == owner_hash
        and claim["disposition"] == old["disposition"]
        and claim["reason"] == old["review_reason"],
        "existing form claim, owner or decision differs",
    )
    for name, expected in authority["evidence_inputs"].items():
        require(content_sha256(historical_read(name)) == expected, "form evidence hash differs")
    native = authority["native_review"]
    for name, expected in (
        (native["path"], native["sha256"]),
        (str(Path(native["path"]).with_name("review.md")), native["markdown_sha256"]),
    ):
        require(content_sha256(historical_read(name)) == expected, "native form review differs")
    owner_links = proof["owner_chains"].get(old["owner_record"], [])
    earlier = [item for item in owner_links if item["sequence"] <= sequence]
    require(
        earlier
        and earlier[-1]["after_sha256"] == owner_hash
        and not any(
            item["sequence"] > sequence and item["before_sha256"] != item["after_sha256"]
            for item in owner_links
        ),
        "form owner changed after checkpoint",
    )
    target = claim["source_position"]
    state = proof["states_after_sequence"][sequence]
    require(
        type(target) is int and 1 <= target <= len(state) and state[target - 1] == row,
        "form checkpoint row differs",
    )
    continuation = []
    for index in range(sequence, len(proof["receipts"])):
        receipt = proof["receipts"][index]
        require(
            not any(change.get("before_position") == target for change in receipt["changes"]),
            "form row changed after checkpoint",
        )
        destination = receipt["position_map"][target - 1]
        require(destination is not None, "form row removed after checkpoint")
        path = proof["receipt_paths"][index]
        continuation.append(
            {
                "sequence": receipt["sequence"],
                "path": path,
                "sha256": proof["receipt_inputs"][path],
                "before_position": target,
                "after_position": destination,
            }
        )
        target = destination
    require(
        target == position and continuation[-1]["before_position"] == position,
        "new form continuation is not position-preserving",
    )
    expected_form = {
        "file": form["file"],
        "claim_kind": claim["claim_kind"],
        "row_sha256": claim["row_sha256"],
        "native_review": native,
        "assessment_id": claim["assessment_id"],
        "checkpoint": checkpoint,
        "prior_basis": claim["prior_basis"],
        "continuation": continuation[:-1],
    }
    require(form == expected_form, "historical form continuation or authority differs")
    expected = deepcopy(old)
    expected["basis"]["form_followup"]["continuation"] = continuation
    superseded = expected["basis"].get("superseded_scoped_review")
    if superseded is not None:
        require(
            superseded["receipt_inputs"]
            == {p: proof["receipt_inputs"][p] for p in proof["receipt_paths"][:-1]},
            "historical supersession receipt inputs differ",
        )
        superseded["receipt_inputs"] = dict(proof["receipt_inputs"])
    require(new == expected, "unrelated base evidence exceeds native provenance continuation")


def verify_owned_name_suppression(prior, before, current, context):
    """Return a captured transition proof; no caller-supplied replay is accepted."""
    from mediaingredientmech.ingredient_bundle_refresh import OwnedNameSuppressionContext

    require(type(context) is OwnedNameSuppressionContext, "explicit exact context required")
    require(context.root.absolute() == context.root.resolve(), "aliased context root")
    root = context.root.resolve()
    require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", context.baseline), "durable baseline required")
    require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", context.manifest_sha256), "invalid caller manifest pin")
    tree = _tree(root, context.baseline)
    inputs: dict[str, str] = {}

    def bind(name, raw):
        digest = content_sha256(raw)
        require(
            name not in inputs or inputs[name] == digest, "conflicting proof input hash: " + name
        )
        inputs[name] = digest
        return raw

    def read(name):
        return bind(name, member(root, name).read_bytes())

    def historical_read(name):
        raw = read(name)
        _historical_equal(tree, name, raw)
        return raw

    def ref(value):
        raw = read(value["path"])
        require(
            content_sha256(raw) == value["sha256"], "pinned reference differs: " + value["path"]
        )
        return raw

    for name, loaded in _LOADED.items():
        require(read(name) == loaded, "loaded verifier differs: " + name)
    for name, raw in before.items():
        _historical_equal(tree, name, raw)
    for name, raw in current.items():
        require(read(name) == raw, "current snapshot differs: " + name)
    require(
        content_sha256(current[MANIFEST]) == context.manifest_sha256, "caller manifest pin differs"
    )
    old_manifest, manifest = read_json(before[MANIFEST]), read_json(current[MANIFEST])
    prefix, updates = old_manifest.get(UPDATE, []), manifest.get(UPDATE)
    require(
        isinstance(prefix, list)
        and isinstance(updates, list)
        and len(updates) == len(prefix) + 1
        and updates[:-1] == prefix,
        "expected one manifest history append",
    )
    immutable_old = {k: v for k, v in old_manifest.items() if k not in {"artifacts", UPDATE}}
    require(
        immutable_old == {k: v for k, v in manifest.items() if k not in {"artifacts", UPDATE}},
        "historical manifest attribution changed",
    )
    update = updates[-1]
    _shape(update, "update")
    require(
        update["prior_manifest_sha256"] == content_sha256(before[MANIFEST])
        and update["baseline"] == context.baseline,
        "manifest predecessor differs",
    )
    plan = read_json(ref(update["plan"]))
    inventory = read_json(ref(update["unchanged_inventory"]))
    _shape(plan, "plan")
    _shape(inventory, "inventory")
    for field in (
        "baseline",
        "unchanged_inventory",
        "artifacts_before",
        "artifacts_after",
        "generation",
    ):
        require(update[field] == plan[field], "manifest/plan field differs: " + field)
    require(inventory["baseline"] == context.baseline, "inventory baseline differs")
    require(
        set(old_manifest["artifacts"]) == set(manifest["artifacts"]) == set(ARTIFACTS),
        "artifact membership differs",
    )
    for name in ARTIFACTS:
        require(
            plan["artifacts_before"][name] == content_sha256(before[name])
            and plan["artifacts_after"][name]
            == content_sha256(current[name])
            == manifest["artifacts"][name],
            "artifact endpoint differs",
        )
    for name in (SIDECAR, BASELINE):
        require(
            old_manifest["artifacts"][name] == plan["artifacts_before"][name],
            "historical policy endpoint differs",
        )
    actual_inventory = source_inventory(root)
    source_bytes = {}
    for folder, key in (
        ("data/ingredients", "ingredient_sha256"),
        ("data/curated", "aggregate_sha256"),
    ):
        expected_paths = sorted(
            name
            for name in tree
            if name.startswith(folder + "/") and Path(name).suffix in {".yaml", ".yml"}
        )
        require(
            actual_inventory[folder] == expected_paths == sorted(inventory[key]),
            "source path inventory differs",
        )
        for name, expected in inventory[key].items():
            raw = read(name)
            require(content_sha256(raw) == expected, "unchanged source hash differs")
            _historical_equal(tree, name, raw)
            source_bytes[name] = raw
    require(set(inventory["protected_sha256"]) == set(PROTECTED), "protected membership differs")
    for name, expected in inventory["protected_sha256"].items():
        raw = read(name)
        require(content_sha256(raw) == expected, "protected source hash differs")
        _historical_equal(tree, name, raw)
        source_bytes[name] = raw
    old_rows, rows, selected = _pairs(plan, before, current, source_bytes)
    _sidecar(plan, before, current)
    generation = plan["generation"]
    generated = {k: ref(generation[k]) for k in ("candidate", "sidecar", "manifest", "receipt")}
    generated_manifest, generated_receipt = read_json(generated["manifest"]), read_json(
        generated["receipt"]
    )
    expected_generated = {
        "sssom": content_sha256(generated["candidate"]),
        "suppressed_aliases": content_sha256(generated["sidecar"]),
    }
    artifacts = generated_manifest.get("artifacts", [])
    require(
        len(artifacts) == 2
        and {item["role"]: item["sha256"] for item in artifacts} == expected_generated,
        "native generation pair attribution differs",
    )
    require(
        generated_manifest.get("external_sssom_validation") == "passed",
        "native generation validation is absent",
    )
    require(
        generated_receipt["producer_revision"]
        == generation["producer_revision"]
        == generated_manifest["source_revisions"]["claw"],
        "generation producer differs",
    )
    for key, field in (
        ("candidate", "candidate_sha256"),
        ("sidecar", "sidecar_sha256"),
        ("manifest", "native_generation_manifest_sha256"),
    ):
        require(
            generated_receipt[field] == content_sha256(generated[key]),
            "generation artifact attribution differs",
        )
    require(
        generated_receipt["prior_sha256"] == plan["artifacts_before"][SSSOM_SOURCE]
        and generated_receipt["input_bytes_unchanged"] is True
        and generated_receipt["scientific_approval_added"] is False,
        "generation preimage/scope differs",
    )
    _, candidate_rows = _table(
        b"".join(
            line
            for line in generated["candidate"].splitlines(keepends=True)
            if not line.startswith(b"#")
        )
    )
    _, diagnostic_rows = _table(generated["sidecar"])
    for pair in plan["pairs"]:
        subject, key = pair["before_row"]["subject_id"], pair["token_key"]
        require(
            not any(r["subject_id"] == subject and r["token_key"] == key for r in diagnostic_rows),
            "fresh candidate origin requires new scope",
        )
        require(
            not any(
                r["subject_id"] == subject
                and any(t.strip().casefold() == key for t in r["other"].split("|"))
                for r in candidate_rows
            ),
            "candidate still publishes selected token",
        )
    proof = verify_mapping_chain(root)
    for name, expected in proof["input_hashes"].items():
        require(
            name not in inputs or inputs[name] == expected,
            "conflicting native replay input: " + name,
        )
        inputs[name] = expected
        require(content_sha256(read(name)) == expected, "native replay input changed")
    old_receipts = {
        name for name in tree if name.startswith(RECEIPTS_DIR + "/") and name.endswith(".json")
    }
    require(
        receipt_inventory(root) == set(proof["receipt_paths"]), "complete receipt inventory differs"
    )
    require(
        set(proof["receipt_paths"][:-1]) == old_receipts
        and len(proof["receipt_paths"]) == len(old_receipts) + 1,
        "expected exact old receipt prefix plus one suffix",
    )
    for name in (*proof["receipt_paths"][:-1], *HISTORICAL_CONTEXT):
        _historical_equal(tree, name, read(name))
    receipt = proof["receipts"][-1]
    sequence = len(proof["receipts"])
    require(
        type(plan["receipt_sequence"]) is int and plan["receipt_sequence"] == sequence,
        "receipt sequence differs",
    )
    require(
        update["mapping_receipt"]
        == {
            "path": proof["receipt_paths"][-1],
            "sha256": proof["receipt_inputs"][proof["receipt_paths"][-1]],
            "sequence": sequence,
        },
        "final receipt reference differs",
    )
    require(
        receipt["issue"] == ISSUE and receipt["scope"] == SCOPE and receipt["approval"] == APPROVAL,
        "receipt attribution differs",
    )
    require(
        receipt["before_sha256"] == plan["artifacts_before"][SSSOM_SOURCE]
        and receipt["after_sha256"] == plan["artifacts_after"][SSSOM_SOURCE],
        "receipt endpoints differ",
    )
    require(
        proof["states_after_sequence"][sequence - 1] == old_rows and proof["state"] == rows,
        "native before/after payload differs",
    )
    require(
        receipt["changed_rows"] == 23
        and receipt["added_rows"] == receipt["removed_rows"] == 0
        and receipt["position_map"] == list(range(1, len(rows) + 1)),
        "receipt exceeds exact 23-cell transition",
    )
    changes = [
        {
            "kind": "changed",
            "before_position": pos,
            "after_position": pos,
            "before": old_rows[pos - 1],
            "after": rows[pos - 1],
        }
        for pos in sorted(selected)
    ]
    require(receipt["changes"] == changes, "native change payload differs")
    expected_records = [expected_record(p, update["plan"]) for p in plan["pairs"]]
    require(
        sorted(receipt["records"], key=lambda r: r["source_record"])
        == sorted(expected_records, key=lambda r: r["source_record"]),
        "export-only owner records differ",
    )
    require(
        receipt["touched_subjects"] == sorted(p["before_row"]["subject_id"] for p in plan["pairs"]),
        "receipt touched subjects differ",
    )
    checkpoints = [
        r["sequence"]
        for r in proof["receipts"][:-1]
        if r["after_sha256"] == old_manifest["artifacts"][SSSOM_SOURCE]
    ]
    require(len(checkpoints) == 1, "historical manifest checkpoint is not unique/reachable")
    checkpoint = checkpoints[0]
    require(
        update["historical_checkpoint"]
        == {
            "sequence": checkpoint,
            "sssom_sha256": old_manifest["artifacts"][SSSOM_SOURCE],
            "bridge_sequences": list(range(checkpoint + 1, sequence)),
        },
        "historical checkpoint bridge differs",
    )
    base_old, base_new = (read_json(values[prior["base_review"]]) for values in (before, current))
    old_decisions = {d["source_position"]: d for d in base_old["decisions"]}
    new_decisions = {d["source_position"]: d for d in base_new["decisions"]}
    require(
        set(old_decisions) == set(new_decisions) == set(range(1, len(rows) + 1)),
        "base decision coverage differs",
    )
    require(
        all(
            old_decisions[p]["disposition"] == new_decisions[p]["disposition"]
            for p in old_decisions
        ),
        "scientific disposition changed",
    )
    require(
        all(
            old_decisions[p]["disposition"] == new_decisions[p]["disposition"] == "WITHHOLD"
            for p in selected
        ),
        "affected mapping is not withheld",
    )
    evidence_documents = {
        label: {
            name: read_json(values[name])
            for name in {d["review_evidence"] for d in decisions.values()}
        }
        for label, values, decisions in (
            ("before", before, old_decisions),
            ("current", current, new_decisions),
        )
    }
    for p in old_decisions.keys() - selected.keys():
        require(old_decisions[p] == new_decisions[p], "unrelated base decision changed")
        a, b = old_decisions[p], new_decisions[p]
        old_evidence = evidence_documents["before"][a["review_evidence"]]["entries"][
            a["evidence_key"]
        ]
        _continued_form_evidence(
            old_evidence,
            evidence_documents["current"][b["review_evidence"]]["entries"][b["evidence_key"]],
            p,
            content_sha256(source_bytes[a["owner_record"]]),
            proof,
            historical_read,
        )
    # The completed external log is attribution, not a result to trust for transition proof.
    log = update["publication_log"]
    _publication_log_path(root, log, inputs.keys() | before.keys() | current.keys())
    read(log)
    require(source_inventory(root) == actual_inventory, "source inventory changed during proof")
    return {
        "baseline": context.baseline,
        "caller_pinned_manifest_sha256": context.manifest_sha256,
        "manifest_before_sha256": content_sha256(before[MANIFEST]),
        "appended_update": update,
        "native_receipt": proof["receipt_paths"][-1],
        "native_receipt_sha256": proof["receipt_inputs"][proof["receipt_paths"][-1]],
        "receipt_paths": proof["receipt_paths"],
        "source_paths": actual_inventory,
        "input_sha256": inputs,
        "scientific_approval_added": False,
        "attribution_contract": "Generation bytes and producer attribution are pinned; generation replay belongs to the guarded publisher.",
        "native_transition_contract": "Full native receipt payload replay, immutable durable prefix/source inventories, exact23 other cells, and unchanged dispositions verified.",
    }
