def profile_index_coherence_1256(root, *, mode, target, final_only):
    """Schedule actual Git writes after actual reads, without replacing native code."""
    events = []
    staged = False

    def profile(frame, event, result):
        nonlocal staged
        if final_only and frame.f_code is owner.finish_receipt.__code__ and event == "call":
            if not staged:
                run_git(root, "add", "-A", "--", "data/ingredients")
                staged = True
        if events or frame.f_code is not owner.git.__code__ or event != "return":
            return
        if frame.f_back.f_code is not owner._check_mutation_git_state.__code__:
            return
        if final_only:
            receipt = root / "receipt/application.json"
            if not receipt.exists() or not receipt.read_bytes():
                return
            if json.loads(receipt.read_bytes()).get("state") != "complete":
                return
        args = frame.f_locals["args"]
        trigger = ("cat-file", "blob") if mode == "owner_blob" else ("diff", "--cached")
        if args[:2] != trigger:
            return
        if mode == "stat_refresh":
            logical_before = owner.git(root, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z")
            index = root / ".git/index"
            raw_before = index.read_bytes()
            contract = root / "MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md"
            info = contract.stat()
            os.utime(contract, ns=(info.st_atime_ns, info.st_mtime_ns + 2_000_000_000))
            run_git(root, "update-index", "--refresh")
            events.append(
                {
                    "mode": mode,
                    "raw_index_changed": raw_before != index.read_bytes(),
                    "logical_index_unchanged": logical_before
                    == owner.git(root, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z"),
                }
            )
            return
        path = target if mode == "owner_blob" else "MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md"
        if mode == "delete":
            run_git(root, "update-index", "--force-remove", "--", path)
        elif mode == "mode":
            run_git(root, "update-index", "--chmod=+x", "--", path)
        elif mode == "stage":
            blob = run_git(root, "rev-parse", ":" + path)
            raw = f"100644 {blob} 2\t{path}\0".encode()
            subprocess.run(
                ["git", "-C", str(root), "update-index", "-z", "--index-info"],
                input=raw,
                check=True,
                capture_output=True,
            )
        else:
            raw = b"unapproved concurrent index-only bytes\n"
            blob = (
                subprocess.run(
                    ["git", "-C", str(root), "hash-object", "-w", "--stdin"],
                    input=raw,
                    check=True,
                    capture_output=True,
                )
                .stdout.decode()
                .strip()
            )
            run_git(root, "update-index", "--add", "--cacheinfo", "100644", blob, path)
        events.append({"mode": mode, "actual_git_result": result})

    return profile, events


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["edit", "create", "promote", "demote"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["contract_blob", "owner_blob"])
def test_1256_coherent_index_rejects_actual_final_read_races(tmp_path, kind, mode):
    """W08-7D4DB26-SRC-001: cached-list and owner-read results cannot outlive index drift."""
    import sys

    plan = head_lifecycle_case(tmp_path, kind)
    ready = prepare(tmp_path)
    entry = plan["records"][0]
    contract = (tmp_path / "MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md").read_bytes()
    profile, events = profile_index_coherence_1256(
        tmp_path, mode=mode, target=entry["source_record"], final_only=True
    )
    previous = sys.getprofile()
    sys.setprofile(profile)
    try:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Git index changed during live source check"):
            owner.apply(ready, tmp_path / "receipt", enabled=True)
    finally:
        sys.setprofile(previous)
    assert len(events) == 1
    receipt = json.loads((tmp_path / "receipt/application.json").read_bytes())
    assert receipt["state"] == "failed" and receipt["recovery_required"]
    assert owner.hashes(owner.inventory(tmp_path)) == ready.after_inventory
    assert (tmp_path / "MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md").read_bytes() == contract
    assert (tmp_path / CANONICAL).read_bytes() == SSSOM
    assert run_git(tmp_path, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == plan["baseline_commit"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        owner.verify_completed(
            tmp_path, tmp_path / "plan.json", tmp_path / "receipt/application.json"
        )

@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["edit", "create", "promote", "demote"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("target_kind", ["contract", "owner"])
def test_1256_captured_invalid_index_is_not_hidden_between_equal_snapshots(
    tmp_path, kind, target_kind
):
    """IR-INDEX-COHERENCE-001: the actual observed entries must be validated."""
    import sys

    plan = head_lifecycle_case(tmp_path, kind)
    ready = prepare(tmp_path)
    target = (
        plan["records"][0]["source_record"] if target_kind == "owner" else "MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md"
    )
    state = {"staged": False, "started": False, "snapshots": 0}
    observed = []
    good_blob = bad_blob = None

    def complete():
        p = tmp_path / "receipt/application.json"
        return (
            p.exists()
            and bool(p.read_bytes())
            and json.loads(p.read_bytes()).get("state") == "complete"
        )

    def set_blob(blob):
        run_git(tmp_path, "update-index", "--add", "--cacheinfo", "100644", blob, target)

    def profile(frame, event, result):
        nonlocal good_blob, bad_blob
        if (
            frame.f_code is owner.finish_receipt.__code__
            and event == "call"
            and not state["staged"]
        ):
            run_git(tmp_path, "add", "-A", "--", "data/ingredients")
            state["staged"] = True
        if (
            frame.f_code is owner._check_mutation_git_state.__code__
            and event == "call"
            and complete()
            and not state["started"]
        ):
            state["started"] = True
            good_blob = run_git(tmp_path, "rev-parse", ":" + target)
            stage_index_only_1256(tmp_path, target, b"invalid captured authority\n")
            bad_blob = run_git(tmp_path, "rev-parse", ":" + target)
        if not state["started"] or frame.f_code is not owner.git.__code__:
            return
        if frame.f_back.f_code is not owner._check_mutation_git_state.__code__:
            return
        if frame.f_locals["args"] != ("ls-files", "--stage", "-z"):
            return
        if event == "call":
            state["snapshots"] += 1
            if state["snapshots"] == 2:
                set_blob(bad_blob)
        elif event == "return":
            observed.append(result)
            if state["snapshots"] == 1:
                assert os.fsencode(bad_blob) in result
                set_blob(good_blob)

    previous = sys.getprofile()
    sys.setprofile(profile)
    try:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="view differs from captured Git index"):
            owner.apply(ready, tmp_path / "receipt", enabled=True)
    finally:
        sys.setprofile(previous)
    assert state["started"] and state["snapshots"] == 1
    assert len(observed) == 1 and os.fsencode(bad_blob) in observed[0]
    assert run_git(tmp_path, "rev-parse", ":" + target) == good_blob
    saved = json.loads((tmp_path / "receipt/application.json").read_bytes())
    assert saved["state"] == "failed" and saved["recovery_required"]
    assert owner.hashes(owner.inventory(tmp_path)) == ready.after_inventory
    assert run_git(tmp_path, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == plan["baseline_commit"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        owner.verify_completed(
            tmp_path, tmp_path / "plan.json", tmp_path / "receipt/application.json"
        )

def sssom(rows):
    out = io.StringIO()
    out.write(
        "# mapping_set_id: https://example.org/fixture\n# predicate_semantics: skos\n"
        "# mapping_date: 2026-10-01\n# mapping_set_version: 2026-10-01\n"
    )
    writer = csv.DictWriter(out, fieldnames=list(rows[0]), delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return out.getvalue().encode()


def history(root, before):
    rows = c.table(before)[2]
    put(root, native.BASELINE, {"schema_version": 1, "source_sha256": c.sha(before), "rows": rows})
    for path in (native.TRAIT_REFRESH, native.PARENT_REFRESH):
        put(
            root,
            path,
            {
                "schema_version": 1,
                "before_sha256": c.sha(before),
                "after_sha256": c.sha(before),
                "row_count": len(rows),
                "changed_rows": 0,
                "changes": [],
            },
        )
    (root / native.RECEIPTS_DIR).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        a, b, m = (capture.ref(g[key]) for key in ("candidate", "sidecar", "manifest"))
        return a, b, json.loads(m)

    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_owner_proof", verify_owner)
    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_generation", generation)
    return {
        "root": root,
        "path": path,
        "plan": plan,
        "out": out,
        "records": records,
        "before": before,
        "owner_proof": owner_proof,
    }


def save(case):
    case["path"].write_bytes(c.encoded(case["plan"]))


def demotion_case(case):
    """Isolate publisher boundaries; the separate integration uses real source proof."""
    root, plan = case["root"], case["plan"]
    old = "data/ingredients/mapped/A.yaml"
    destination = "data/ingredients/unmapped/A.yaml"
    (root / old).unlink()
    raw = b"identifier: UNMAPPED_0002\npreferred_term: A\nmapping_status: AMBIGUOUS\n"
    put(root, destination, raw)
    record = case["records"][0]
    record.update(
        kind="demote",
        shape="demotion",
        before_source_record=old,
        source_record=destination,
        source_path=old,
        destination_path=destination,
        after_yaml_sha256=c.sha(raw),
    )
    after = case["owner_proof"]["after_inventory"]
    after.clear()
    after.update(inventory(root))
    candidate_ref = plan["generation"]["candidate"]
    _, _, rows, _ = c.table((root / candidate_ref["path"]).read_bytes())
    candidate = sssom([r for r in rows if r["subject_id"] != "MIM:A"])
    put(root, candidate_ref["path"], candidate)
    candidate_ref["sha256"] = c.sha(candidate)
    plan["rows"][0].update(owner=destination, native_position=None, preserve_fields=[])
    plan["rows"][1]["native_position"] = 1
    plan["rows"][2]["native_position"] = 2
    save(case)
    return case

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "role", ["candidate", "manifest", "owner_plan", "owner_receipt", "owner", "receipt_inventory"]
)
def test_late_drift_never_leaves_success_receipts(case, monkeypatch, phase, role):
    real = c.publish_validated
    called = False

    def drift():
        root, plan = case["root"], case["plan"]
        if role in {"candidate", "manifest"}:
            p = root / plan["generation"][role]["path"]
        elif role in {"owner_plan", "owner_receipt"}:
            p = root / plan[role]["path"]
        elif role == "owner":
            p = root / case["records"][0]["source_record"]
        else:
            p = root / native.RECEIPTS_DIR / "late.json"
        p.write_bytes(b"late drift")

    def wrapper(target, render, recheck):
        nonlocal called
        if called:
            return real(target, render, recheck)
        called = True
        if phase == "before":
            drift()
        result = real(target, render, recheck)
        if phase == "after":
            drift()
        return result

    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "publish_validated", wrapper)
    with pytest.raises((ValueError, FileNotFoundError)):
        c.publish(case["root"], case["path"], case["out"], apply=True)
    assert (case["out"] / "publication.json").read_bytes() == b""
    assert (case["root"] / native.RECEIPTS_DIR / "issue1174-fixture.json").read_bytes() == b""
    assert (case["out"] / "canonical-before.tsv").read_bytes() == case["before"]

@pytest.mark.parametrize("filename", ["canonical-before.tsv", "policy-before.json"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "phase",
    ["backup_flush", "before_publication", "after_canonical", "before_finish", "after_finish"],
)
def test_1214_inplace_recovery_corruption_never_completes(case, monkeypatch, filename, phase):
    from contextlib import contextmanager

    backup = case["out"] / filename
    mutated = []
    before_policy = (case["root"] / c.POLICY).read_bytes()

    def corrupt():
        assert not mutated
        identity = backup.stat()
        expected = backup.read_bytes()
        assert expected
        backup.write_bytes(b"corrupted same-inode recovery evidence\n")
        actual = backup.stat()
        assert (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino) == (actual.st_dev, actual.st_ino)
        assert backup.read_bytes() != expected
        mutated.append(True)

    if phase == "backup_flush":
        reserve = c._reserve

        class CorruptAfterFlush:
            def __init__(self, handle):
                self.handle = handle

            def __getattr__(self, name):
                return getattr(self.handle, name)

            def flush(self):
                self.handle.flush()
                if not mutated:
                    corrupt()

        @contextmanager
        def late_backup_flush(paths):
            with reserve(paths) as (handles, parents):
                modified = list(handles)
                index = list(paths).index(backup)
                modified[index] = CorruptAfterFlush(handles[index])
                yield modified, parents

        monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_reserve", late_backup_flush)
    elif phase in {"before_publication", "after_canonical"}:
        publish_validated = c.publish_validated

        def late_publication(*args, **kwargs):
            if phase == "before_publication" and not mutated:
                corrupt()
            result = publish_validated(*args, **kwargs)
            if phase == "after_canonical" and not mutated:
                corrupt()
            return result

        monkeypatch.setattr(c, "publish_validated", late_publication)
    else:
        finish_receipt = c.finish_receipt

        def late_completion(*args, **kwargs):
            if phase == "before_finish":
                corrupt()
            result = finish_receipt(*args, **kwargs)
            if phase == "after_finish":
                corrupt()
            return result

        monkeypatch.setattr(c, "finish_receipt", late_completion)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="reserved recovery backup changed"):
        c.publish(case["root"], case["path"], case["out"], apply=True)
    assert mutated == [True]
    assert (case["out"] / "publication.json").read_bytes() == b""
    receipts = list((case["root"] / native.RECEIPTS_DIR).glob("*.json"))
    assert len(receipts) == 1 and receipts[0].read_bytes() == b""
    if phase in {"backup_flush", "before_publication"}:
        assert (case["root"] / c.SOURCE).read_bytes() == case["before"]
        assert (case["root"] / c.POLICY).read_bytes() == before_policy
    # The accepted immutable beforeimages remain independently available.
    for role in ("canonical", "policy"):

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "phase", ["reserved", "after-first-replace", "before-completion", "after-completion"]
)
def test_1256_late_commit_never_leaves_success_receipts(case, monkeypatch, phase):
    from contextlib import contextmanager

    root = case["root"]
    before = {p: (root / p).read_bytes() for p in (c.SOURCE, c.POLICY)}
    entered = []

    def change_head():
        entered.append(phase)
        commit_publication_boundary(root)

    if phase == "reserved":
        original = c._reserve

        @contextmanager
        def reservation(paths):
            with original(paths) as handles:
                change_head()
                yield handles

        monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_reserve", reservation)
    elif phase == "after-first-replace":
        original = c.publish_validated

        def replacement(*args, **kwargs):
            result = original(*args, **kwargs)
            change_head()
            return result

        monkeypatch.setattr(c, "publish_validated", replacement)
    else:
        original = c.finish_receipt

        def completion(*args, **kwargs):
            if phase == "before-completion":
                change_head()
            result = original(*args, **kwargs)
            if phase == "after-completion":
                change_head()
            return result

        monkeypatch.setattr(c, "finish_receipt", completion)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="live publication HEAD changed"):
        c.publish(root, case["path"], case["out"], apply=True)
    assert entered == [phase]
    if phase == "reserved":
        assert all((root / p).read_bytes() == raw for p, raw in before.items())
    for path in [
        case["out"] / "publication.json",
        root / native.RECEIPTS_DIR / (case["plan"]["batch"] + ".json"),
    ]:
        assert not path.exists() or path.read_bytes() == b""

def test_real_completed_native_suffix_then_suppression_preserves_original_27(tmp_path):
    plan, path, destination, before, proof = real_case(tmp_path, prior_native=True)
    assert len(plan["receipt_prefix"]) == 28
    native_proof = c.native.verify_mapping_chain(tmp_path)
    assert [r["sequence"] for r in native_proof["receipts"]] == list(range(1, 29))
    last = tmp_path / native_proof["receipt_paths"][-1]
    original = tmp_path / native_proof["receipt_paths"][0]
    for fault in (
        "tampered-original",
        "disconnected-suffix",
        "missing-suffix",
        "undeclared-suffix",
    ):
        old_original, old_last, old_plan = (
            original.read_bytes(),
            last.read_bytes(),
            path.read_bytes(),
        )
        try:
            if fault == "tampered-original":
                original.write_bytes(old_original + b"\n")
            elif fault == "disconnected-suffix":
                value = c.read_json(old_last)
                value["before_sha256"] = "f" * 64
                last.write_bytes(c.encoded(value))
            elif fault == "missing-suffix":
                last.unlink()
            else:
                value = copy.deepcopy(plan)
                value["receipt_prefix"].pop(last.relative_to(tmp_path).as_posix())
                path.write_bytes(c.encoded(value))
            with pytest.raises((ValueError, FileNotFoundError)):
                c.prepare(tmp_path, path)
            assert not (destination / "publication.json").exists()
            assert all(
                (tmp_path / p).read_bytes() == before[k]
                for k, p in (("canonical", c.SOURCE), ("policy", c.POLICY), ("sidecar", c.SIDECAR))
            )
        finally:
            original.write_bytes(old_original)
            last.write_bytes(old_last)
            path.write_bytes(old_plan)
    assert c.publish(tmp_path, path, destination, apply=True)["status"] == "complete"
    completed = c.native.verify_mapping_chain(tmp_path)
    assert len(completed["receipts"]) == 29
    assert all(completed["receipt_inputs"].get(p) == h for p, h in plan["receipt_prefix"].items())
    assert (tmp_path / c.SIDECAR).read_bytes().startswith(before["sidecar"])
    assert len(c._suppression_table((tmp_path / c.SIDECAR).read_bytes())[0]) == 38
    assert c.validate(tmp_path, path)["status"] == "verified"

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "fault",
    [
        "review-after-canonical",
        "third-destination-failure",
        "sidecar-backup-before-finish",
        "sidecar-backup-after-finish",
        "owner-membership-after-finish",
        "head-after-finish",
    ],
)
def test_real_third_target_and_review_boundaries_clear_success_receipts(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, fault
):
    plan, path, destination, before, _ = real_case(tmp_path)
    original_publish, original_finish = c.publish_validated, c.finish_receipt
    touched = False

    def publication(current, render, check):
        nonlocal touched
        if fault == "third-destination-failure" and current.path == tmp_path / c.SIDECAR:
            touched = True
            raise RuntimeError("injected third-destination failure")
        result = original_publish(current, render, check)
        if fault == "review-after-canonical" and current.path == tmp_path / c.SOURCE:
            touched = True
            selection = c.read_json((tmp_path / plan["suppression_review"]["path"]).read_bytes())
            review_file = tmp_path / selection["transition_review"]["yaml"]["path"]
            review_file.write_bytes(
                review_file.read_bytes() + b"\n# changed after canonical write\n"
            )
        return result

    def completion(*args, **kwargs):
        nonlocal touched
        backup = destination / "sidecar-before.tsv"
        if fault == "sidecar-backup-before-finish":
            touched = True
            backup.write_bytes(b"same-inode corruption\n")
        result = original_finish(*args, **kwargs)
        if fault == "sidecar-backup-after-finish":
            touched = True
            backup.write_bytes(b"late same-inode corruption\n")
        elif fault == "owner-membership-after-finish":
            touched = True
            (tmp_path / "data/ingredients/mapped/Unexpected.yaml").write_bytes(
                b"identifier: CHEBI:1\npreferred_term: Unexpected\nmapping_status: MAPPED\n"
            )
        elif fault == "head-after-finish":
            touched = True
            git(
                tmp_path,
                "-c",
                "user.name=Fixture",
                "-c",
                "user.email=fixture@example.invalid",
                "commit",
                "--allow-empty",
                "-qm",
                "Injected intervening commit",
            )
        return result

    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "publish_validated", publication)
    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "finish_receipt", completion)
    with pytest.raises((ValueError, RuntimeError)):
        c.publish(tmp_path, path, destination, apply=True)
    assert touched
    assert (destination / "publication.json").read_bytes() == b""
    assert (tmp_path / c.native.RECEIPTS_DIR / (plan["batch"] + ".json")).read_bytes() == b""
    assert (tmp_path / c.BASELINE).read_bytes() == before["baseline"]
    for name, expected in plan["receipt_prefix"].items():
        assert c.sha((tmp_path / name).read_bytes()) == expected
    if fault in {"review-after-canonical", "third-destination-failure"}:
        assert (tmp_path / c.SIDECAR).read_bytes() == before["sidecar"]
    if not fault.startswith("sidecar-backup"):
        assert (destination / "sidecar-before.tsv").read_bytes() == before["sidecar"]

def derive(case):

        "bool-version",
        "float-version",
        "unknown-selection",
        "wrong-transition",
        "missing-actual-input",
        "wrong-actual-input",
        "native-event-cell",
        "wrong-current-root",
        "owner-role",
        "baseline-hash",
        "prefix",
        "wrong-reviewed-target",
    ],
)
def test_actual_transition_review_cannot_be_replaced_by_self_issued_checksums(
    suppression_case, fault
):
    case = suppression_case
    root, _, plan, _, _, _, _, _, _, _ = case
    selection, review = reviewed_selection(case)
    if fault == "bool-version":
        selection["schema_version"] = True
    elif fault == "float-version":
        selection["schema_version"] = 1.0
    elif fault == "unknown-selection":
        selection["allow"] = True
    elif fault == "missing-actual-input":
        selection["transition_review"]["inputs"].pop(
            next(iter(selection["transition_review"]["inputs"]))
        )
    elif fault == "wrong-actual-input":
        ref = next(iter(selection["transition_review"]["inputs"].values()))
        ref["sha256"] = "f" * 64
    elif fault == "wrong-reviewed-target":
        review["targets"][0]["selector"] = "subject=MIM:Other; token_key=other"
        module = c._BOUND_NATIVE["campaign_native_record_review"]
        selection["transition_review"]["yaml"] = put(
            root, "reports/actual-review/review.yaml", module._dump_document(review).encode()
        )
        selection["transition_review"]["markdown"] = put(
            root,
            "reports/actual-review/review.md",
            module.render_markdown(review, c.LOADED_PRODUCERS[c.REVIEW_SCHEMA].path).encode(),
        )
    else:
        transition = c.read_json((root / selection["transition"]["path"]).read_bytes())
        if fault == "wrong-transition":
            transition["approval"] = "SUPPORTED"
        elif fault == "native-event-cell":
            transition["events"][0]["native_event"]["token"] = "other"
        elif fault == "wrong-current-root":
            transition["events"][0]["source_ref_joins"][0]["actual_root"] = "/other"
        elif fault == "owner-role":
            transition["events"][1]["owners"][1]["kind"] = "selected"
        elif fault == "baseline-hash":
            transition["after_sha256"]["baseline"] = "f" * 64
        elif fault == "prefix":
            transition["receipt_prefix"].pop(next(iter(transition["receipt_prefix"])))
        selection, _ = reviewed_selection(case, transition)
    plan["suppression_review"] = put(root, "reports/selection.json", selection)
    with pytest.raises((ValueError, KeyError)):
        project(case)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "fault",
    [
        "missing-input",
        "input-bytes",
        "native-markdown",
        "owner-bytes",
        "before-owner",
        "create-preimage",
        "unchanged-operation",
        "operation-case",
        "credit-extra",
        "event-extra",
        "event-missing",
        "old-duplicate",
        "old-no-newline",
        "prefix-missing",
        "source-locator",
    ],
)
def test_authentic_transition_refuses_incomplete_or_changed_binding(suppression_case, fault):
    case = list(suppression_case)
    root, capture, plan, before, proof, diagnostic, canonical, needs, bundle, _ = case
    if fault == "missing-input":
        bundle["inputs"].pop(next(iter(bundle["inputs"])))
    elif fault == "input-bytes":
        (root / next(iter(bundle["inputs"].values()))["path"]).write_bytes(b"changed")
    elif fault == "native-markdown":
        bundle["markdown"] = put(root, bundle["markdown"]["path"], b"not a native rendering")
    elif fault == "owner-bytes":
        name = next(iter(proof["after_inventory"]))
        (root / name).write_bytes(b"changed")
    elif fault == "before-owner":
        proof["before_inventory"]["data/ingredients/mapped/Bacto_Peptone.yaml"] = "f" * 64
    elif fault == "create-preimage":
        proof["before_inventory"]["data/ingredients/mapped/Corn_Starch.yaml"] = "f" * 64
    elif fault == "unchanged-operation":
        proof["records"].append({"source_record": "data/ingredients/mapped/Bluensomycin.yaml"})
    elif fault == "operation-case":
        proof["records"][0]["origins"][0]["case_hashes"] = {}
    elif fault == "credit-extra":
        path = "data/ingredients/mapped/Extra.yaml"
        ref = put(
            root, path, b"identifier: cas:1-2-3\npreferred_term: Peptone\nmapping_status: MAPPED\n"
        )
        proof["after_inventory"][path] = ref["sha256"]
    elif fault == "event-extra":
        case[7] = needs + [dict(needs[0], subject_id="MIM:Extra")]
    elif fault == "event-missing":
        case[7] = needs[:-1]
    elif fault == "old-duplicate":
        before["sidecar"] += before["sidecar"].splitlines(keepends=True)[1]
    elif fault == "old-no-newline":
        before["sidecar"] = before["sidecar"].rstrip(b"\n")
    elif fault == "prefix-missing":
        plan["receipt_prefix"].pop(next(iter(plan["receipt_prefix"])))
    elif fault == "source-locator":
        case[5] = diagnostic.replace(b"#synonyms[28]", b"#synonyms[29]")
    with pytest.raises((ValueError, KeyError)):
        derive(case)
